items.prompt:
将上传的照片转化为一张时尚的 OUTFIT OF THE DAY（今日穿搭）编辑风时尚拼贴画，采用 3:4 竖版构图。

上半部分（50%）：
生成一张人物全身高端时尚大片，穿着与参考图中完全一致的服装。保留人物的面部特征、发型、服饰、色彩、配饰、鞋履及自然身材比例。使用干净温暖的象牙白摄影棚背景、柔和的自然光线，以及轻松自然的模特姿态。

下半部分（50%）：
在一个精致的大号陶瓷盘上，创作一幅充满创意的平铺时尚情绪板（moodboard）。将各个穿搭单品以逼真的纸质剪贴贴纸形式呈现，带有细微的白边和柔和阴影，包括：
- 人物的剪贴肖像。
- 上衣、裤子或裙子。
- 鞋子和袜子。
- 帽子、包包、珠宝及配饰。
- 画面中可见或与穿搭相关的其他物品。

将所有元素在盘中进行美学排布，仿佛在展示一份完整的穿搭配方。

设计与细节：
在盘子上方添加优雅的复古风字体，内容为“{argument name="caption" default="OUTFIT OF THE DAY"}”。使用马卡龙条纹背景，盘子两侧放置超大号的银色刀叉，并点缀小巧的手绘闪光和俏皮的涂鸦。

视觉风格：
韩国高端时尚杂志美学，Pinterest 风格的编辑设计，温暖的奶油色调，柔和的马卡龙色系，逼真的产品摄影，手账拼贴风，纸质剪贴贴纸效果，柔和阴影，俏皮灵动的构图与精致的复古格调。

重要提示：自动识别上传照片中的服装与配饰。请勿凭空捏造不同的穿搭，也不要改变人物身份。平铺图中的每一件物品都必须与实际穿搭或其可见配饰一一对应。

items.title: 摄影与厚涂油画对比海报
items.prompt:
使用上传的照片，制作一张 3:4 竖版高级感摄影与厚涂油画对比海报。

### 布局
将画布水平等分为上下两部分（50/50）：
- 上半部分：原始照片。
- 下半部分：艺术化厚涂油画演绎。

两部分必须通过一条干净的横向分界线直接衔接，不得出现间隙、渐变或重叠。

### 上半部分 —— 摄影
完整保留原主体的身份特征、数量、姿态、比例、轮廓、细节、构图、透视、光影与自然色彩。仅做轻微的高级感调色处理。切勿重绘、扭曲、复制、移位或改动主体。不添加任何文字或装饰元素。

### 下半部分 —— 艺术演绎
将同一主体重新构想为具有雕塑感的厚涂油画微景观。运用厚重的层叠颜料、刮刀肌理、手工塑形质感、隆起的边缘以及富有表现力的笔触。

保持主体清晰可辨，居中或略微偏离中心放置，四周留出大面积暖白色留白。引入一道源自原照片的色带，将其转化为地面、水面、小径或抽象景观元素。

### 色彩与肌理
从原照片中提炼出一组和谐且克制的有限色盘。在保留主体自然色彩特质的同时，赋予其微妙的光泽与明亮度。有选择性地使用浓郁的颜料肌理，搭配精致的主体细节与细腻的哑光纸张纹理。

### 排版
在下半部分的留白区域内，添加一行简短优雅的英文标题及一行小号辅助说明文字。采用纤细极简的字体风格。文案内容需基于实际主体或意境生成。避免凭空捏造日期、地点、标志、签名及多余注释。

### 美学风格
静谧、极简、精致，兼具杂志大片质感。通过留白、雕塑般的立体深度、材质肌理与均衡构图，营造出值得收藏的艺术出版物美学。

### 避免事项
照片拼贴、主体变形、无关场景、插画风摄影、多余的标题栏、画面杂乱、过度装饰、错误文本、水印、卡通风格、荧光色、过度饱和、色调浑浊、塑料感 3D 效果以及廉价 CGI 质感。

- 手绘水彩与彩色铅笔质感。

- 全身人物插画。
- 人物居中放置。
- 预留充足的白色留白空间。

将上传的照片转化为一幅温馨可爱、充满奇思妙想的手绘彩色铅笔与蜡笔拼贴画插画。

重要提示 —— 保留原照片内容：

首先，请仔细分析上传的照片。准确识别画面中的主体、人物、面部特征、发型、服装、姿势、表情、配饰、物品以及背景环境。

将这张照片重新创作成一幅迷人的插画作品。请保留原有的构图、可辨识的面部特征、服装细节、身体姿态及人物互动关系。切勿随意替换或凭空捏造主要拍摄对象。

艺术风格：
- 纯正的手绘彩色铅笔与蜡笔插画风格。
- 清晰可见的铅笔笔触、颗粒质感以及略带随性的手绘线条。
- 柔和的水彩般上色效果，搭配浓郁的彩铅阴影。
- 细腻的交叉排线与层层叠加的手绘细节。
- 略带粗糙感、充满怀旧气息的儿童绘本插画美学。
- 温暖、梦幻、惬意且充满童趣的氛围。
- 奶油色纹理纸张背景。
- 柔和的光线，带有温暖的亮部与轻柔的阴影。
- 浓郁却略带褪色感的复古色调。

拼贴装饰：

在主插画四周点缀俏皮的手工拼贴画边框，包含以下元素：
- 粉色与红色的闪粉爱心贴纸。
- 小巧的彩色宝石与珍珠串珠。
- 金色星星与水晶装饰。
- 精致的手绘小花与蝴蝶。
- 可爱的涂鸦、笑脸和小星星。
- 小巧的装饰叶片与应季元素。
- 多彩的手绘轮廓线与俏皮的符号。

让这些装饰看起来就像真实贴在画作边缘的实体贴纸和微小饰物。

构图：

保持主体位于视觉中心。运用细腻的彩铅质感还原原始场景。装饰性拼贴元素主要分布在画面外缘，切勿遮挡照片中的重要部分。

整幅作品应呈现出精美个人日记本的一页，或是怀旧图文回忆录般的视觉效果。

最终美学效果：

极致细腻、可爱温馨、怀旧文艺、柔和复古的拼贴画美学，纯手工插画质感，清晰可见的蜡笔颗粒与彩铅肌理，自然的手绘瑕疵美，温暖的柔和色调，迷人的装饰点缀，高品质的插画日记页面。

重要提示：最终效果必须呈现为纯手绘插画，而非套用卡通滤镜的照片。请避免照片级写实、3D 渲染、塑料质感以及过度平滑的数字绘画效果。

items.title: 复古美式卡通风格图像转换
items.prompt:
将上传的图片原封不动地转化为全身插画，采用 20 世纪 60 至 80 年代美国复古卡通风格。必须完整保留原图中的主体、面部特征、发型、服装、配饰、色彩、比例、姿势、肢体语言、表情、拍摄角度、取景、构图、透视、光影以及所有可见细节。不得重新设计、主观演绎、简化、替换或凭空添加任何元素。上传的图片必须保持一眼可辨，仅改变艺术风格。

角色应采用夸张的“橡皮管”（rubber hose）比例、富有表现力的肢体语言、略微偏大的头部、简化的身体结构、柔韧有弹性的四肢、带有简单黑色瞳孔的经典大椭圆卡通眼、纤细灵动的眉毛、圆润的双手和简洁的几何造型，并透出俏皮的复古气质；同时必须精准还原原图人物的样貌、神态与轮廓剪影。

插画需具备粗重的黑色轮廓线、平涂纯色、极简的赛璐珞风格阴影、淡淡的复古胶片颗粒质感、类似老式动画赛璐珞片的轻微褪色色调、流畅的手绘 2D 线条、简单的色块处理、柔和的复古印刷肌理，整体呈现经典的 20 世纪中叶美国动画美学。

除非另有说明，否则请完全按照上传图片中的原样保留背景。

严格保持原有的构图、取景、透视与镜头角度不变。若原图中为全身像，则插画中也必须呈现完整的全身。高分辨率，画面干净利落；拒绝写实风、3D 渲染、日系动漫风、Pixar 风、Disney 风及现代卡通风，只保留纯正的 20 世纪 60 至 80 年代美国复古动画美学。

嘴角微微上扬，神态温柔恬静，双眼直视镜头，流露自然亲切感。

[发型 - 核心]

浓密蓬松的深栗棕色长发，泛有自然巧克力棕光泽，长度垂至胸部以下、接近腰部。

自然中分造型，部分头发在脑后随意拢起，形成轻微的半扎发效果。

几缕细碎发丝自然垂落在额头与脸颊两侧。

画面左侧的头发自然别至耳后，露出耳朵与小巧珍珠耳环。

画面右侧大量浓密长发自然披散于肩头与胸前，形成柔和松散的大波浪。

[服装与首饰]

长袖设计，袖口自然贴合手腕，面料呈现细腻真实的编织纹理与柔软褶皱。

颈部佩戴极细银色锁骨链，一侧耳朵戴着小巧的白色珍珠耳钉。

整体穿搭简约、温柔、优雅。

[姿势 - 重点]

人物坐在卧室床沿，上半身微微转向镜头，双肩自然放松下沉。

头部轻轻偏向画面右侧，下巴微收，目光温柔地直视镜头。

画面左侧的一只手自然抬起，掌心轻触脸颊与耳下，手指顺着下颌线自然舒展，形成温柔的托腮姿势。

另一只手抬至肩侧，手指轻轻拨弄胸前的长发，指尖自然弯曲。

长发自然垂落于身体右侧，双手位置高低错落，构成自然柔和的画面构图。

保持真实的手指数量、自然的手腕角度以及合理的肩颈比例。

温馨简约的现代卧室或酒店房间。

画面左侧是一扇大型落地窗，挂着半透明白色纱帘，窗帘带有柔和自然的垂直褶皱。

人物身后是一张铺着纯白床品的柔软大床。

画面右后方可见浅米色床头板与暖黄色床头灯光。

墙面为奶油白与浅米色，室内干净整洁，无繁杂杂物。

整体营造出真实居家夜晚休憩的温暖氛围。

[镜头与光影]

9:16 竖版，上半身特写人像构图，等效 35-50mm 镜头，平视视角，人物居中。

头顶预留少量空间，长发自然延伸至画面底部。

采用柔和冷白正面补光，均匀照亮眼部、脸颊与嘴唇，使肌肤呈现干净通透的冷白质感。

右侧背景的床头灯散发柔和暖黄环境光，形成自然的冷暖色温对比。

头发受光面呈现细腻的栗棕色高光，暗部保留浓郁的深棕色。

整体亮度适中，对比度略微降低，保留自然阴影、真实发丝、细腻面料纹理以及轻微的智能手机摄影颗粒感。

[负面提示词]

动漫，插画，3D 渲染，CG 假脸，塑料感皮肤，过度磨皮，夸张网红脸，眼睛异常偏大，下巴过尖，五官错位，双眼不对称，浓妆，假发，头发结块，过于规则的卷发，手指畸形，多指，手部融合，手腕扭曲，肩膀脱臼，身体比例失调，针织纹理错误，衣服穿模，背景杂乱，强 HDR，严重过曝，过度锐化，商业影棚布光，明显 AI 生成痕迹，文字，水印，logo，拼贴画。

一位 23 至 25 岁的成年东亚美女，拥有精致的小鹅蛋脸、清透的冷白皮、深灰棕色杏眼、柔和的玫瑰粉色双唇，以及浓密及腰的乌黑长发。

她站在夏日森林的浅溪旁，身穿纯白色短款修身针织开衫，内搭浅粉色上衣。

身体侧对镜头，头部自然回转，目光安静地直视相机。

一只手抬起靠近耳畔，轻轻整理黑色长发；另一只手自然弯曲，置于身前。

背景是清澈流动的森林溪流，水面上散落着天然圆润的灰色鹅卵石，四周环绕着茂密的深绿色树木。

明亮的夏日阳光穿透树林，在人物发丝、脸颊、肩膀和溪流水面上形成真实的斑驳光影。

整体画面清新、安静、自然，带有柔和的韩式初恋感与清冷气质。

真实摄影光学质感，自然的皮肤纹理，细腻的发丝，轻微的柔焦与真实相机颗粒感，避免商业影棚质感和明显的 AI 生成痕迹。

[面部特征]

23 至 25 岁的成年东亚美女。

精致小巧的鹅蛋脸，头身比例自然，额头饱满柔和，颧骨平滑，面颊带有轻微的自然柔和肉感。

下颌线从两侧自然收窄，下巴小巧微圆，面部轮廓精致流畅。

五官和谐精致，散发着安静、清冷的韩式美女气质。

肌肤呈现清透的奶油冷白色，双颊带有极淡的蜜桃粉色红晕。

保留真实的皮肤微观纹理、自然毛孔以及细腻的面部光影过渡。

眼睛为深灰棕色杏眼，瞳孔清澈明亮，眼型自然偏大，眼尾微微上扬。

自然细致的双眼皮，柔和的卧蚕，浅灰棕色眼影，紧贴睫毛根部的细眼线。

睫毛自然纤长分明，眉毛为柔和自然的深灰棕色平眉。

鼻梁纤细挺直，山根过渡自然，鼻尖小巧圆润。

双唇自然饱满，唇峰柔和，涂抹低饱和度的玫瑰豆沙粉色口红。

上下唇轻轻闭合，嘴角放松，不刻意微笑。

目光清冷、温柔且安静，带有一丝若有所思的神态。

人物直视镜头，面部表情自然放松。

[发型设计 - 重点]

极其浓密的乌黑长发，发色为自然的深黑茶棕色。

头发长度及腰以下，发量丰厚但具有自然的蓬松感。

头顶发量丰盈，发根自然挺立，呈现真实的头发体积感。

发型采用自然的中分设计。

额头留有少量轻薄、不规则的空气感碎刘海。

几缕细碎的刘海自然垂落在额头中央，部分发丝轻轻遮盖在眉毛附近。

脸颊两侧有轻薄的八字形修饰发丝，部分自然贴合面部。

大部分乌黑长发披散在肩后，顺着背部自然垂落至腰部。

另一部分长发从肩部自然向前滑落。

发丝整体顺直，带有轻微的自然大弧度波浪。

几缕细碎的散发受林间微风影响，在脸颊和头顶周围轻轻飘动。

阳光从人物左上方照射，在头顶和外层发丝上形成自然的银白色与深棕色反光。

头发层次分明，能看清每一根真实的细软发丝。

避免过于死板的直发、假发般的质感以及僵硬的头发轮廓。

[服装搭配]

身穿纯白色短款修身针织开衫。

开衫采用致密柔软的棉质针织面料，具有真实的细罗纹结构。

长袖设计，袖管贴合手臂自然轮廓。

上衣版型修身，面料柔软，衣长在腰线以上。

前襟自然微敞，形成柔和的纵向层次感。

下摆自然收边，带有柔软的针织褶皱。

内搭一件简约的浅樱花粉色上衣，仅在白色开衫领口和下摆之间露出少许浅粉色面料。

下半身隐约可见浅米色或卡其色高腰裙的腰部边缘。

整体服装色彩以纯白、浅粉和浅米色为主。

白色针织面料在阳光下微微提亮，但保留了真实的织物细节。

服装简约自然，没有夸张的印花、LOGO 或复杂的装饰。

[人物姿态 - 核心]

人物站在清澈溪流旁的浅水石滩上。

身体呈约 60 至 70 度侧角，双肩微微转向画面左侧。

上半身自然挺直，腰部呈现柔和的自然曲线。

头部轻轻向后回转，面部朝向镜头。

下巴微收，双眼平静地注视相机。

画面右侧的手臂自然抬起，手肘向外弯曲。

手掌轻轻放在耳畔的长发上。

食指、中指及其余手指自然弯曲，轻轻拢起一束黑色长发。

手指与头发之间呈现真实自然的接触关系。

画面左侧的另一只手臂自然向上弯曲。

手掌位于胸部左侧，手指微卷，呈现放松自然的姿态。

双肩放松下沉，不刻意耸肩。

浓密的乌黑长发顺着肩膀和背部自然垂落，部分发丝遮挡住背部轮廓。

整体姿态宛如朋友在溪边随手抓拍下的一个自然回眸瞬间。

肩膀、手臂、手腕、手指和脖颈的比例真实，符合人体解剖学结构。

[背景环境 - 重点]

写实的夏日山林溪流环境。

人物站在一条清澈、缓缓流淌的小溪旁。

溪水从画面左上方的远处自然流向底部。

水面透明清澈，呈现浅灰绿、淡青绿以及自然的银白色反光。

溪流中分布着许多大小不一的圆润石头。

石头颜色包括浅灰、深灰、青灰以及少量的浅棕色。

部分石头露出水面，部分淹没在清澈的溪水中。

远处可见浅水流过石头时激起的细小白色水花。

左侧背景主要为明亮的溪水、天然鹅卵石和被阳光照亮的绿色植物。

右侧背景是阴影较深的森林。

大量的深绿色树叶、灌木和树干构成了茂密的自然林地背景。

溪岸边有一条微湿的灰色碎石小路。

林间上方的阳光穿过树叶缝隙，在溪水和石头表面投下不规则的斑驳光斑。

远景背景具有自然的空间纵深感，部分溪流和树木略微模糊。

没有建筑物、人工水池、木桥、路灯或其他人物。

整体环境原始、自然、清透，具备真实山谷溪流的空灵感。

[镜头与构图]

严格的 1:1 正方形画幅比例，单张独立人像。

采用等效 50mm 至 70mm 人像镜头视角。

机位接近人物视平线，呈现自然的平视视角。

人物位于画面中心偏右的位置。

构图从头顶上方保留少许背景开始，向下延伸至人物腰部附近。

人物头顶靠近画面上边缘。

面部位于画面居中偏上的位置，双眼作为视觉焦点。

人物身体转向画面左侧，头部自然回转。

一只手在耳畔整理头发，另一只手自然抬至胸前。

长发垂落至画面底部，遮挡住部分背部。

画面左侧保留较多空间，用于展现明亮的森林溪流。

画面右侧保留深绿色的树林、灰色鹅卵石和天然的溪岸。

人物的面部、眼睛、嘴唇和乌黑长发保持清晰锐利。

溪流和近处的石头具有一定的自然清晰度，远处的树木适度虚化。

使用真实相机的景深效果，不要制造极度夸张的人像模式背景虚化。

[自然光影设计 - 最重要]

明亮的夏日森林自然光摄影。

午后的阳光穿透茂密的树冠，从画面左上方照射下来。

左侧背景的溪流被强烈的阳光照亮，形成大量明亮的银白色水面反光。

右侧背景的树林处于自然阴影中，保持着浓郁的深绿色调。

人物位于阳光与树荫的交界处。

面部受到柔和的天空漫射光和溪面反射光照亮，整体肤色明亮自然。

额头、鼻梁、脸颊和下巴带有细腻自然的高光。

人物头顶呈现明显但不刺眼的阳光反光，照亮了细小的散发。

鼻梁和脸颊保留轻微的自然阴影，赋予五官真实的立体感。

白色针织开衫被阳光照亮，呈现出明亮干净的纯白色。

人物的肩膀和手臂具有柔和的光影层次。

溪面出现轻微的局部过曝和真实的高光闪烁。

背景明暗对比鲜明，但面部曝光始终保持自然。

整体呈现出真实相机在明暗反差强烈的森林环境中拍摄的效果。

不使用商业影棚补光、夸张的逆光光束或人造柔光滤镜。

[色彩与摄影质感]

整体采用低饱和度的韩式森林清冷绿色调。

主色调为深林绿、浅青绿、自然灰、纯白、乌黑和淡玫瑰粉。

背景森林呈现浓郁的墨绿色和深青绿色。

溪水为透明的浅绿灰色，在阳光下泛着银白色高光。

人物肤色清透冷白，双颊带有淡淡的粉色红晕。

头发为浓郁的乌黑色，受光区域呈现细腻的深棕色反光。

白色针织上衣明亮干净，浅粉色内搭保持柔和的低饱和色调。

整体亮度适中，人物比背景稍微明亮一些。

保留真实的阴影和自然的高光，适度降低饱和度。

细腻的皮肤纹理、根根分明的发丝、真实的水波纹和鹅卵石质感。

轻微的真实相机颗粒感，适度的自然柔焦，不过度锐化。

拒绝过度修图、塑料感皮肤以及明显的 CG 或 AI 渲染质感。

单张独立图像，无文字，无水印，无 LOGO，无拼图，无边框。

[反向提示词]

动漫，插画，卡通，3D 渲染，CG 假脸，塑料感皮肤，过度修图，夸张美颜滤镜，下巴过尖，眼睛异常放大，五官错位，双眼不对称，瞳孔变形，浓妆，夸张假睫毛，表情僵硬，假发，头发打结，发丝走向错误，头发过于规整，多余的手指，手指粘连，手掌变形，抓握动作错误，多余的手臂，肩膀脱臼，脖子异常，身体比例扭曲，服装结构错误，针织面料穿模，衣服过于透明，溪流变成游泳池，水面结构异常，石头粘连，石头重复，树木纹理错误，背景过度虚化，面部严重过曝，强 HDR，过度锐化，商业影棚布光，明显的 AI 生成痕迹，文字，LOGO，水印，拼图。

items.title: GPT Image 2 彩色铅笔插画
items.prompt:
将上传的照片转化为精美的手绘彩色铅笔插画，同时完整保留原照片的内容、构图与情感氛围。

1. 参考图精准度
仔细分析上传的照片，包括人物身份、面部特征、发型、表情、姿势、服装、配饰、身体比例、周围物品、背景、拍摄角度、透视关系、光线以及独特的微小细节。

以插画形式重现相同场景。保留人物的辨识度与原场景的精确布局。切勿改变姿势、凭空添加新物品、删减重要细节或改动原始环境。

2. 艺术风格
采用传统彩色铅笔与蜡笔插画风格，呈现出在米色纹理素描本纸张上手工绘制的精美效果。

需包含：
- 清晰可见的彩铅笔触与细腻的交叉排线。
- 柔和且略带随性的手绘轮廓线。
- 层次分明的铅笔阴影，笔触力度自然变化。
- 细微的纸张纹理与淡淡的蜡笔质感。
- 温暖柔和的色彩，带有淡雅的粉彩色调。
- 略带草图感的轮廓线与迷人的手工痕迹。
- 色彩过渡自然，避免平滑的数字渐变效果。
- 发丝细节丰富，用流畅的独立笔触逐一勾勒。
- 面部神态生动，特征经过简化但依然易于辨认。
- 通过层层叠加的铅笔笔触营造柔和阴影，而非照片般的明暗处理。

3. 色彩搭配
使用温暖怀旧的色彩组合，包括奶油米色、灰粉色、柔和棕色、暖焦糖色、炭黑色、浅灰色及淡雅的大地色系。在忠实还原原照片真实色彩的同时，将其转化为传统插画的色彩表现。

4. 背景与环境
如实重现原始背景，包括家具、门、墙壁、街道、人行道、栏杆、植物、宠物、建筑及其他可见元素。

用随性却考究的铅笔笔触刻画背景细节。保持原有的景深、透视与空间关系，让整个画面呈现和谐统一的手绘插画质感。

5. 光影与氛围
保留原始的光照方向与整体氛围。营造温馨、私密、怀旧的意境，仿佛这一刻被定格在私人插画日记或画家的素描本中。

6. 最终效果
整幅图像必须呈现出真正在纹理纸上用彩色铅笔手绘的效果，绝不能像套用艺术滤镜的照片。

保持原始宽高比与构图。全图贯穿精细的插画细节、自然的线条、可见的铅笔颗粒感、恰到好处的手工瑕疵以及统一的手绘质感。

重要提示：上传的照片是场景的唯一参考依据。请务必保留其中的人物特征、姿势、物品与构图，仅将视觉表现形式转化为传统插画。

高级时尚大片摄影，超现实主义室内设计。一位年轻女子（参考照片）坐在圆桌旁。桌上铺着鲜艳的红白格纹桌布，摆放着一把光泽莹润的绿色茶壶和几只黄色茶杯。她坐在红色椅子上，身旁是一张线条流畅的红色弧形沙发。背景是色彩对比强烈的色块拼接角落，一侧为亮橙红色墙面，另一侧为深钴蓝色墙面。地面铺设着绿、蓝、红相间的彩色格纹瓷砖。高反差定向光投射出戏剧性的阴影，电影感构图，韦斯·安德森式对称美学，超精细细节，8k 分辨率。

高级时尚大片摄影，活力超现实主义。一张对称式棚拍肖像：一位女子（参考照片）挺直腰背坐在白色椅子上阅读报纸。背景是一面纯深宝蓝色墙壁，两侧各挂着一幅带框波普艺术画作：左侧是重复排列的红色爱心图案，右侧是绿茎上的风格化红色郁金香。椅子两旁立着两个红色基座，上面摆放着插满鲜艳粉色玫瑰的红色花瓶。地面为纯正浓郁的绿色。线条利落，大胆的原色与间色配色方案，商业影棚布光，超精细细节，8k 分辨率。

高级时尚大片摄影，超现实主义棚拍肖像。一位女子居中站立，背景为纯宝蓝色。她身穿红色高领内搭，外搭剪裁利落的红绿格纹西装（西装外套搭配阔腿裤），佩戴鲜艳的红色太阳镜、夸张的大号圆形金色耳环以及红色尖头鞋。她双手在胸前举起一幅带框画，画中呈现“画中画”效果——画面里的她身穿纯红色西装外套，背景为纯绿色。大胆的色块碰撞，线条利落，高反差影棚布光，超精细细节，8k 分辨率。

items.title: 秋季插画贴纸转化
items.prompt:
将上传的照片转化为一张充满魅力的手绘风格秋季插画贴纸。

保留原始主体：精准还原照片中的人物、宠物或群体，完整保留可辨识的面部特征、发型、服装、色彩、姿势、表情及标志性细节。

插画风格：将主体完全重新绘制为精致的数字角色插画，采用柔和的手绘光影、流畅自然的轮廓线、富有表现力的五官、细腻的纹理以及温暖的秋日色调。避免照片级写实与 3D 渲染效果。

贴纸效果：在整个插画主体外围添加厚实平滑的白色模切边框，并配以淡淡的阴影，营造逼真的贴纸质感。

秋日氛围：巧妙融入应景的季节元素，例如橙色落叶、迷你南瓜、温暖舒适的衣物、浆果、橡果或暖色光斑。配色以焦橙色、陶土红、焦糖色、奶油白和暖棕色为主。

背景处理：保留原始照片背景在贴纸后方可见，必要时可做轻微的柔化处理。

最终效果：生成一张温馨、个性化且极具收藏感的秋季贴纸，让纯插画风格的主体与真实的照片背景形成鲜明对比。请勿仅对原图简单套用滤镜或描边。

items.title: 个性化手相指南信息图
items.prompt:
目标：创建一张竖版信息图风格的手相指南，标题为 {argument name="title text" default="你的个人指南"}。
画布：采用干净、现代的布局，白底黑字，分为三个主列。整体风格极简且富有科普感，类似于高端健康或自我提升类 App 的界面。
布局：
- 左列：顶部区域以大号粗体字显示标题“你的个人指南”，下方紧跟副标题“认识自己 · 专注成长 · 持续进化”。其下是一张张开的右手（掌心朝前）写实照片。再往下依次为：“你的手”板块，列出惯用手、元素、手型及手指特征等细节；“快速总结”板块；以项目符号列表呈现的“优势”板块；以及同样以项目符号列表呈现的“关键关注点”板块。
- 中列：顶部区域展示一张详细的黑白指纹扫描图像，标注为“掌印图”。其下是一幅手部线描示意图，标注为“主要掌纹图”，图中带有编号的线条（1-5）分别对应特定的掌纹。下方是“手型类型”柱状图板块，展示火、风、土、水四种元素的占比。底部是关于“掌丘”的图例，解释其各自含义。
- 右列：包含五张独立的卡片，详细解读特定掌纹：1. 感情线，2. 智慧线，3. 生命线，4. 命运线，5. 太阳线。每张卡片均包含描述与解析。这些卡片下方是“最终建议”提示框和“备注”区域。
视觉风格：卡片使用细黑边框。图标应为简约线条画（如心形、大脑、盾牌）。文字需采用清晰的无衬线中文字体。指纹图像应具备高对比度，纹路清晰可见。
文本内容：确保所有中文标签与提供的图片完全一致，包括“手相解读”、“掌印图”等标题，以及各条掌纹的具体解析内容。

items.title: 六款杂志封面
items.prompt:
生成一张高分辨率横版图片，在纯白背景上并排展示六本风格各异的杂志封面。所有封面的主角均为同一位动漫风格的年轻女性——齐肩棕发、蓝色眼眸，但每本封面都根据杂志类型为她搭配了不同的服装与造型。

从左至右，各封面内容如下：
1. 女性时尚：标题为“凛と日和”。她身穿珊瑚色上衣搭配白色长裤，手提一款包包。
2. 动漫/游戏：标题为“アニマギア”。她身着未来感十足的霓虹紫色偶像打歌服，点缀着发光细节。
3. 商业：标题为“週刊ビジネス羅針盤”。她穿着干练的深灰色职业套装，手持一台平板电脑。
4. 旅行：标题为“旅色めぐり”。她身穿休闲橙色外套，以群山风景为背景站立。
5. 烹饪：标题为“おいしい毎日”。她在黄色衬衫外系着围裙，站在摆满新鲜食材的厨房中。
6. 神秘学：标题为“異界探訪”。她身穿暗红色维多利亚风格长裙，置身于神秘幽暗的场景之中。

每本封面都必须包含地道的日文排版、醒目标题以及真实杂志常见的小字文本块。

items.title: GPT Image 2 搞笑召唤仪式提示词
items.prompt:
请绘制一幅充满喜剧效果的画面：附图中的角色举行了一场盛大的召唤仪式，却意外召唤出了令人意想不到的东西。

[角色]
保留原有的面部特征、发型、基础配色和性格特点。根据当前场景调整表情与动作。

[召唤物]
不要照搬示例或候选物品，请为本次场景原创一个全新事物。要与宏大的仪式形成强烈反差，仅凭画面就能让人一眼看出召唤出了什么，并让观众忍不住吐槽“为什么要召唤这个？”。避免局限于与角色外貌或服装直接相关的物品，大胆尝试出人意料的组合。

[场景构图]
分别从不同角度确定召唤物及其大小与状态、角色的反应以及对周围环境的影响，然后将这些元素串联成一个逻辑通顺的完整事件。角色的反应不要只停留在“惊讶”上，要通过表情和肢体动作体现出他与召唤物之间的互动关系。

[表现手法]
让仪式过程显得真实且宏大，利用它与召唤物出现时的巨大落差来制造笑点。核心笑点只保留一个，通过道具和配角的布局来强化这一效果。不要依赖文字说明，要让角色、召唤物和反应在构图中一目了然。如果本次对话中已经生成过同一项目的图片，请勿重复使用之前的召唤物或笑点，需要另辟蹊径。

items.title: GPT Image 2 手绘信息图提示词
items.prompt:
两个纵向相连的圆角矩形面板由极粗、略带起伏的黑色手绘轮廓线锚定，白色卡扣横跨面板边缘，构成醒目的成对模块与清晰的纵向节奏。内容依托格式塔邻近性与版面分区进行组织，每个面板内部划分为稳定的左图右文双栏，左右视觉比重均衡，标题与信息在右栏自上而下阅读；整体视觉重心落在两块面板的交界处及各自醒目的大标题上，页眉区域保持独立，放置 logo 与主标题。图文通过并置与衬底相互衔接：左侧预留给角色或主题插画，置于不规则的圆角浅色干净底座之上；右侧以醒目的大字引领多行说明文字，并在文本旁搭配小型线描符号以提示内容。文字层级始终分明，大标题粗重醒目，说明文字较细且行距宽松，小字与符号形成节奏点；字形结构端正易读，字怀清晰、收笔利落、字面紧凑，与手绘图像相得益彰，无论文字多少均维持该层级；文字不足时，则根据主题补充次要小字。文本边缘平整清晰，在手绘线条之外形成干净的排版层。留白涵盖面板间距、图像底座周围的衬底留白、文本行间的阅读间隙以及页眉与正文之间的停顿；各处均保持宽裕，使粗边框、插画与标题得以清晰凸显。插画内容由所附主题提供，在左栏内采用完整、集中、略微倾斜的手绘构图，主体轮廓简洁，动态细节轻盈，承重部位端正；内容密度约占半幅画面，主要集中在各面板的左栏，其余部分为白色或浅色圆角底座、平整的面板色块及底部留白，不生成任何场景。采用复合技法：以连贯、略带抖动的粗黑线条勾勒边框与角色；以干净平滑的数字平涂铺展大面积面板与局部插画色彩；以利落的文字排版压住信息区；整体呈现出由手绘线条、电脑平涂与清晰排版合成的插画编排效果。配色保持高明度基调，色彩鲜活、饱和而不刺眼，最浓烈的色面落在成对面板内，并与角色局部色彩相呼应；暖调浅色背景与不同明度的浅色色面相互搭配，以强烈的黑白线文对比稳定层次。整体温暖明快、亲切有活力，宛如哑光数字色块与密集马克笔线条的结合；色调随主题变化，但明暗、粗细、饱和度、偏暖倾向以及欢快亲切的心理感受不受主题影响，始终保持这一性格。整体气质轻盈、友好且有序。所附主题、准确文案、用途与宽高比优先；上下面板分组、左图右文、粗黑手绘边框、图像衬底、清晰的文字层级以及高明度暖厚配色方案保持不变。

items.title: 动漫吉祥物版清水寺旅游 LP
items.prompt:
目标：为京都清水寺打造一个内容丰富、信息密集的竖版旅游落地页（LP）。
画布：竖版比例（约 4:5），采用动漫插画与写实摄影的活力混搭风格，以干净的白色为背景，点缀橙色和紫色的笔触。
布局：
1. 头部导航：顶部导航栏左侧为 Logo“あぽろ塾 APOLLO JUKU”，中间为菜单项（Search、Model Course、Spot、Gourmet、Access），右侧为橙色 CTA 按钮“今すぐ旅に出る”。
2. 首屏区域（Hero Section）：大标题“清水寺 Kiyomizu-dera”使用粗体黑色衬线字体。副标题为“京都・東山の絶景と歴史をめぐる”。画面中央是一位动漫角色（橙色头发、猫耳、印有“KYOTO”字样的街头风外套）手指向右方，身旁伴有一只燕尾服猫。背景是京都红叶与古塔交相辉映的全景图。悬浮的手写文字：“見たことのない京都に、きっと出会える。”和“ここにしかない景色がある。”。地点信息区块：“京都・東山”、“早朝散策がおすすめ”、“春は桜、秋は紅葉が人気”。世界遗产徽章及坐标“34.9945, 135.7843”。
3. 亮点区域（“見どころ”）：横向可滑动卡片，展示“清水の舞台”、“音羽の滝”、“三年坂・二年坂”、“京都の街並みを一望”、“世界遺産”的照片。每张卡片包含一张照片、标题和简短描述。
4. 应用与功能区域：左侧是一部智能手机样机，屏幕显示地图应用界面，标注了清水寺、音羽瀑布等地点的图钉。中间一列列出“アプリの主な機能”（App 主要功能）并配有图标：Spot Search、Model Course、Favorites、Offline Map。右侧为“モデルコース”（推荐路线），用编号步骤 01-04 展示路线缩略图。
5. 季节推荐区域（“おすすめの季節”）：四个鲜明的季节区块（春、夏、秋、冬），分别配有对应的风景照片和简短的文字描述。
6. 交通指南区域（“アクセス”）：右下方区域列出交通方式（电车、公交、自驾），并标明具体车站名称和步行时间。包含一个小小的古塔剪影和“Kyoto”字样。
视觉风格：现代日式网页设计美学。色彩丰富的动漫吉祥物与宁静写实的摄影作品形成强烈对比。使用橙色（约 #FF5722）和紫色作为点缀色。正文采用干净的无衬线字体，标题则使用优雅的衬线字体。
文本内容：请完全按照图片所示保留所有日文文本，包括“見どころ”、“モデルコース”、“アクセス”等版块标题以及具体的地名。

items.title: GPT Image 2 提示词：实验性纹理双联画
items.prompt:
为每张上传的照片生成一张 3:4 竖版双联画，上下两半等分且无缝衔接。无需分隔线、边框或拼贴效果。整体风格融合瑞士平面设计、实验摄影与复古印刷美学。

上半部分 —— 原始照片
完整保留原图的人物特征、姿态、场景、构图、透视、光影与色彩。仅允许进行细微的调色和背景延展。不添加任何文字。

下半部分 —— 七个实验性纹理区域
完整重复一次原图。在图像像素上直接叠加七个大小不一的非对称矩形区域，可覆盖非关键细节。确保每个区域内外的视觉连贯性。严禁对图像进行裁剪、缩放、位移、复制或重绘。务必保留所有重要的视觉焦点。

七种编号技法

01. Reeded Glass（竖纹玻璃）：垂直光学折射效果。

02. Black-and-White Engraving（黑白雕版）：精细蚀刻线条与交叉排线。

03. American Stipple（美式点刻）：黑白微点纹理。

04. Vintage Halftone（复古半调）：CMYK 印刷网点。

05. Pixel Mosaic（像素马赛克）：方形像素块。

06. Transparent Overlay（透明叠层）：2–4 层半透明叠加。

07. Duotone Screen Print（双色调丝网印）：双色丝网印刷效果。

设计细节
添加极细边框、微小角标方块以及精细指引线，以标示各个矩形区域。为每种技法标注对应的编号与英文名称。七个区域之外的画面须保持真实的摄影质感。

严格要求
不得出现 logo、水印、多余图片或无谓的装饰元素。维护原图的完整性，呈现干净、高级的杂志排版风格。

输出：一张高清 3:4 竖版海报，上下两半等分。

1. **主立绘**：角色全身插画，身着精致的赛博朋克舞台装，融入全息元素、水晶配饰与飘逸的布料点缀。
2. **服装展示**：多角度视图（正面、侧面、背面），全方位呈现服装设计细节。
3. **表情集**：九种面部表情，包括咧嘴笑、自信、科技达人范、舞台突发状况、严肃、坚定、眨眼、喜悦和坏笑。
4. **细节特写**：局部放大展示靴子与领口、肩甲、背部细节、眼部细节以及发型细节。
5. **材质与纹理**：色卡展示全息银、珍珠白网纱、电光蓝水晶以及霓虹紫点缀效果。
6. **配饰与武器**：展示光环头冠、水晶长枪变体、全息披风及声波耳麦。
7. **战斗姿态**：剪影插画，展现充满张力的动态动作姿势。
8. **武器特效**：攻击动画演示，包括破晓斩击、穿刺突刺以及终极数字和声特效。
9. **概念总览**：核心元素板块，包含配色色卡与主题图标。
10. **风格备注**：文字描述着重突出未来感光效、舞台偶像张力，以及科技与梦幻交织的美学氛围。
11. **角色简介**：定位为偶像/治疗者，属性为水/数字，性格自信且极具标志性。
12. **专属台词**：“当旋律化作你的利刃，连潮汐也将为你臣服。”

整体视觉美学应将赛博朋克科技与空灵奇幻元素完美融合，配色以深蓝、紫色、银色为主调，并辅以发光点缀效果。图中需包含五星评级标识，且全程保持专业游戏美术文档的制作标准。

主题：东方茶品鉴样品。原创品牌“岚虚”，产品“岩茶”（Yancha），主标题“山田入盏”。

一张暖白色宣纸长卷自底部向上折叠为三折高度不一的页面，形似抽象山脊，同时保留真实纸张的厚度、纤维与折痕。最底层放置一把深褐色小茶壶，中层放置一只白瓷茶杯，最高层仅放几片干岩茶叶；物体比例写实且互不重叠。

核心构图：“折页相连—山路层叠—茶烟贯通”。一缕琥珀色茶烟自壶嘴升起，沿着连接茶杯的折叠山路蜿蜒而行，宛如克制的写意水墨笔触，带有局部浓淡变化，但不构成具体文字或龙凤图案。主标题“山田入盏”以现代宋体在右侧留白处竖向排列，顶部小字“岚虚”，底部小字“岩茶”。配色方案：暖白、岩褐、茶汤琥珀色及极少量墨黑。

items.title: 矿泉水轮廓折射海报
items.prompt:
制作一张 4:5 竖版、完成度极高的瓶装矿泉水宣传海报。以“等高线折射谷”作为唯一核心构图，采用略微俯视的垂直视角。一个无标签、结构简约的透明玻璃水瓶竖直立于画面中下方，瓶盖为雾银色金属材质。整个背景铺满极细、等距且连续的冰蓝色水平等高线。线条在靠近瓶身处向内凹陷，形成被瓶身重量压出的柔和峡谷，向远处延伸后恢复平直。线条不得断裂、交叉或产生杂乱的波纹。

水瓶并非悬浮的抠图素材，底部需真实压在浅灰蓝色的矿物表面上，瓶身与线条场处于同一空间。只有透过瓶内清水看到的等高线才会发生真实的折射、轻微放大和水平位移，外部线条保持精准连续。左侧凝结少量自然水珠，右侧带有清晰的高光边缘。整体质感对标高端饮用水广告摄影，杜绝塑料感的 CGI 效果。

将窄体无衬线大标题“{argument name="title" default="FLOW"}”置于上方安静的留白区域，字间距拉宽，颜色为深海军蓝。标题下方仅保留小字“{argument name="subtitle" default="MINERAL WATER"}”。文字不得嵌入瓶身，也不能与线条争夺视觉中心。色彩严格限制在冰蓝、雾白、深海军蓝及少许银色之间。

使用柔和的顶部天光与左后方轮廓光，让瓶身通透而不隐形。整体氛围精准、利落、极简，呈现当代编辑设计风格。采用全不透明的矩形背景覆盖整个画布，不得出现透明像素、黑角、Alpha 蒙版、边缘羽化或不规则裁切。禁止加入山景照片、人物、悬浮水花、冗余文案、现有品牌 Logo 或水印。

items.prompt:

四块深靛蓝色哑光薄板在画面中央等距垂直排列。薄板本身不印任何文字；只有当光束穿过四块板上精确的镂空切口时，后方暖灰色墙面上的投影才会拼出完整的单词“{argument name="word" default="BEAM"}”。每个字母均由光线投射而成，而非贴在墙上的普通发光字体。光束穿过不同切口后，宽度会产生细微变化，并呈现真实的柔和边缘。薄板边缘的高光需克制处理，表面保留清晰的投影方向感。

除标题外，仅在右下角添加小字信息“{argument name="subtitle" default="ARC LAMP / LIGHT SHAPED BY FORM"}”。不使用任何图标、参数卡片或装饰线条。色彩严格限定为深靛蓝、哑光红、暖灰与暖白光。

整体呈现静谧的室内夜景摄影质感。台灯材质需逼真写实。光学关系必须严谨：光源、镂空切口与墙面投影须处于同一直线上。构图简洁且富有空间纵深感。背景为覆盖整个画布的不透明矩形，无透明像素、无黑角、无 Alpha 蒙版、无边缘羽化。不得出现霓虹灯牌、舞台烟雾、赛博朋克元素、人物、现有品牌 Logo 或水印。

items.prompt:
输出一个独立的 {argument name="aspect_ratio" default="4:5"} 竖版商业海报，无拼贴，无多格布局。使用原创虚构品牌，不得模仿现有品牌的包装、Logo 或广告。文本仅可使用提示词中明确列出的品牌名、主标题和类别；不得编造价格、奖项、规格、日期、产地或标语。图像需达到创意总监审核标准：结构真实、材质可信、排版清晰、无水印。

布局：
1. **标题：** 大号衬线字体标题 "THE MOST REMOTE PLACE ON EARTH IS IN THE OCEAN"（其中 "IN THE OCEAN" 以浅蓝色高亮显示）。下方是一个简短的介绍段落，将尼莫点定义为距离陆地最远的位置，并提及距离为 2,688 km (1,671 miles)。
2. **中心地图：** 以南太平洋为中心的风格化世界地图。大陆以柔和的大地色调（绿色、棕色）渲染，与深蓝色海洋形成对比。标签包括 NORTH AMERICA, SOUTH AMERICA, EUROPE, ASIA, AFRICA, AUSTRALIA 和 ANTARCTICA。
3. **数据可视化：** 一个明亮的黄色圆点在复活节岛南部的海洋中标记出 "POINT NEMO"。三条虚线黄色箭头从该点辐射至最近的陆地，并标注了距离：到南极洲 "2,688 km (1,671 miles)"，到南美洲 "2,754 km (1,711 miles)"，到澳大利亚 "2,966 km (1,843 miles)"。
4. **信息框（左侧）：** 一个包含指南针图标的矩形框，内含坐标 "48°52.6'S 123°23.6'W" 和昵称 "oceanic pole of inaccessibility"。
5. **底部部分：** 标题为 "WHY IS IT INTERESTING?" 的部分，包含三列带有图标和文本的内容：
   - 图标：卫星天线。文本："它是距离任何陆地最远的点，使其成为地球上最孤立的地方。"
   - 图标：空间站/卫星。文本："航天器和国际空间站将其用作重新进入大气层或投放物体的最安全地点。"
   - 图标：船只。文本："它如此偏远，以至于最近的人类通常是宇航员——而不是水手。"
6. **页脚：** 地球图标旁边的结语："尼莫点向我们展示，即使在我们探索充分的星球上，也有比陆地上任何地方都更偏远的地方。"

视觉风格：专业信息图设计。正文使用清晰的无衬线字体，标题使用衬线字体。确保地图投影清晰地突出中心点的孤立性。

items.title: 冷面角色产品摄影提示词
items.prompt:
{argument name="character" default="Hatsune Miku"} 成人化写实版本，真人实拍角色摄影，古怪可爱氛围 x 冷面幽默 x 极简白色背景产品照构图。

保留 [Character] 最核心的身份识别特征：发型轮廓、发色、眼睛主色调、面部特征、角色主色、标志性配饰、服装轮廓、头饰、耳朵/角/尾巴/面部符号以及其他关键视觉锚点。整体并非普通的 Cosplay 摆拍，而是将 [Character] 转化为一张极简、干净、荒诞且带有轻微商业感的肖像产品照。人物必须明显是成年人。

人物位于画面中下部，展示半身或四分之三身，面向镜头或略微侧身，单手或双手持握 [Prop]。如果 [Prop] 适合饮用、拥抱、展示、举起、咬住、拿持或倚靠，让 [Character] 与 [Prop] 形成简单、直接、一眼可懂的互动动作。动作要少，但必须清晰，例如：高举、捧持、递向镜头、吸吸管、拥抱、背负、支撑、举至胸前、倚靠面部。重点在于“角色认真地与物品互动”，以此产生幽默感。

[Prop] 占据画面较大比例，接近人物头部或上半身的尺寸，形成超大道具互动效果。道具材质清晰，形状完整，轮廓分明，视觉上成为与人物并列的重要主体。人物与道具的关系应简单、直接、可爱且略带荒诞。

人物表情以冷面（Deadpan）为核心：眼神略显空洞、冷淡、呆滞、轻微疲惫或严肃，仿佛极其认真地做着非常普通的事情。没有夸张的大笑，没有强烈的戏剧性表演。整体氛围为尴尬可爱、柔和荒诞、可爱的商业形象。

构图采用：
底部重心构图 x 大面积留白。
人物和道具集中在画面下方或中下部，上方保留大量纯白空间。背景为白色或极浅灰白色的无缝影棚背景布，极简空间，类似产品广告或角色周边海报。

摄影采用：
高调产品摄影 x 柔和影棚灯光 x 极简影棚肖像。
柔和的前向漫射光，略带影棚感，明亮、干净、阴影极淡。人物皮肤、衣物、头发、配饰与 [Prop] 之间的材质差异必须清晰：布料、金属、塑料、玻璃、纸张、液体、食物等，都应具有明显的质感。

整体视觉要求：
极简，
干净，
大留白，
人物居中偏下，
超大道具比例，
简单清晰的动作，
幽默感源自表情与道具比例，
像高端但轻松的角色广告。

成像清晰，现代商业摄影品质，但非奢华时尚大片，而是更简洁、轻松，如同“角色拿着大物件拍摄产品照”。最终效果类似极简白底真人角色海报：一个写实的 [Character] 站在纯白背景前，认真手持超大 [Prop]，神情呆滞，动作简单，画面大面积留白，笑点直接，外观既可爱又荒诞。

竖版格式。

items.title: GPT Image 2 提示词：酒吧中身穿红裙的女性
items.prompt:
主题：
红裙中的祝酒

主要主体：
画面中央，一位年轻女性坐在高档昏暗酒吧的深红色天鹅绒椅子上。焦点集中在她紧身的酒红色缎面连衣裙、右手纤细的香槟杯以及周围的琥珀色灯光上。

人物与表情：
小巧的椭圆形脸庞，柔和的下颌线，深邃的大棕眼，细眉，精致的鼻梁，微微张开的粉嫩光泽双唇。头部略微向右倾斜，目光流向屏幕左侧，带着平静的微笑。深棕色长卷发从中分处散开，披在肩上，留有稀疏的空气刘海和侧边发丝。

服装与姿势：
短款酒红色缎面连衣裙，配有细肩带，胸前交叉垂坠设计，从腰部到大腿呈现对角线褶皱。佩戴小珍珠耳环、镶嵌黑石的细项链，双手腕戴有精致手链。深深陷入椅中，双腿交叉，左肘靠在扶手上，指尖轻触下巴附近，右手握住酒杯杯脚。

背景与光线：
身后是琥珀色的层架灯光，摆放着酒瓶和玻璃器皿；右后方有布艺灯罩台灯和红花；左右两侧可见深红色椅子。左前方黑色大理石桌上放着蜡烛和小盘子。来自左右的温暖层架光和台灯柔和地打在脸部和缎面上，背景呈现圆形散景效果。

构图与相机：
3:4 竖构图，正面相机高度与坐姿人物齐平，捕捉从头顶到交叉膝盖的半身肖像。人物位于中心且占比大，酒杯在右上，蜡烛在左下。右腿在底部边缘被裁剪，焦点在眼睛和酒杯上，酒吧层架深度虚化。

质感与风格：
逼真的实拍照片风格。展现缎面、天鹅绒、大理石、玻璃的高清深层光泽以及自然皮肤光泽，由酒红色和琥珀色调统一的电影感夜景。

负面提示：
改变裙子颜色和交叉腿姿势；省略酒杯或酒吧灯光

items.title: Dark Fantasy Inner Monster Poster
items.titleZh: A dark fantasy gothic poster in a vertical composition, painted in a highly detailed anime-inspired style with dramatic lighting and rich texture. At the center is a beautiful young woman with long straight {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} hair, pale skin, and an elegant, calm but dangerous presence. Her face is mostly obscured in shadow and mystery. She wears an ornate black-and-deep-blue crystalline dress with lace, feathered and jagged organic details, semi-transparent flowing sleeves, and glowing blue highlights across the bodice and collar, as if infused with magic. Her right hand is raised slightly with an open gesture, while her left hand rests lower near her waist. Surrounding and partly growing from her are luminous blue butterflies and shard-like petals, creating a sense of transformation and corruption. Behind her looms a gigantic monstrous entity made of darkness, ink, smoke, and cosmic texture, with exactly 7 glowing blue eyes visible and a huge fanged grin packed with sharp icy-blue teeth. The creature feels Lovecraftian, predatory, and intimate, curling around her like a guardian, curse, or inner demon. The palette is dominated by black, midnight navy, indigo, and electric blue, with sparkling highlights like stars or wet paint splatter. Add a decorative antique silver filigree border in all 4 corners and along the edges, making it feel like a sinister book cover or exhibition poster. Place large Japanese title text at the top: {argument name="title text" default="私の中のバケモノ"}. Add 8 blocks of vertical Japanese copy around the figure, 4 on the left and 4 on the right, in elegant white Mincho-style type. Left side text blocks, top to bottom: 「創造の源、すべてを壊し、すべてを生む。」, 「正しさよりも、心が動く瞬間を信じる。」, 「美しいものに飢えている。」, 「静けさの中で、世界をかき混ぜる。」. Right side text blocks, top to bottom: 「感情を深く、人の痛みも、希望も、まるごと抱きしめる。」, 「枠を壊し、誰も見たことのない景色を描きたい。」, 「怖い、危ない、それでも止められない。」, plus a short atmospheric handwritten-style accent near the mid-right edge. At the lower center, add a large Japanese question line: {argument name="bottom question" default="これは、力？それとも、呪い？"}. At the very bottom, add a smaller Japanese line: {argument name="tagline text" default="私の中のバケモノは、私だけの物語を待っている。"}. Make the whole image feel obsessive, beautiful, unsettling, and emotionally intense, like a high-end dark art poster about inner monsters and creative power.

items.title: Japanese Elephant Day Magazine Feature
items.titleZh: Create a soft, elegant Japanese lifestyle magazine editorial page in a warm botanical watercolor style, formatted as a full-page A4 portrait layout with a cream paper background, thin beige border, muted sage-green accents, and a refined nature-themed design. The page is a single cohesive magazine spread design with 6 distinct content sections: 1 large main illustration panel on the left, 1 tall title-and-article column on the upper right, 3 stacked informational point boxes on the mid-to-lower right, 2 small photo-card style image panels along the lower left, 1 circular quote badge near the lower left of the main panel, and 1 summary box at the lower right. The theme is elephant appreciation day in Japan. At the top left, place small editorial header text reading "LIFESTYLE / FEATURE / TOPIC" with a short Japanese subtitle beneath it. Across the upper right, add the large date heading "4.28 EVENT" and the main Japanese headline "象の日特集" in an elegant serif style, with a short subheading line beneath it and a tiny elephant icon. Below that, set 3 short Japanese body paragraphs in a clean magazine column, explaining elephant day. The main illustration panel shows a gentle elephant standing on the left, rendered in delicate watercolor with realistic wrinkles, large ears, soft ivory-gray skin, and a lowered trunk reaching toward a small child standing beside it. The child is an androgynous anime-style boy with messy wavy dark purple-black hair, pale skin, large eyes, a black graphic T-shirt with a purple emblem, loose brown knee-length cargo shorts, and bare feet, standing casually with one hand in a pocket while touching the elephant’s trunk with the other. Behind them is a sunny zoo walkway with a wooden fence, soft green trees, dappled light, and leafy branches hanging from above. Near the elephant, include a small wooden sign reading "Elephant 4.28". Add a circular text badge in Japanese near the lower left of the main image. On the lower left area, place exactly 2 small bordered snapshot-style panels with taped-corner scrapbook presentation: the first labeled "Feeding Time" showing the child in side profile offering leaves to the elephant’s trunk across a fence; the second labeled "Peaceful Time" showing the child seated on a wooden bench in profile with elephants in the background, in a calm reflective scene. Each small panel has a short Japanese caption underneath. On the right side, stack exactly 3 informational boxes labeled "POINT 01", "POINT 02", and "POINT 03" in olive green circles, each with a simple line icon and Japanese text: box 1 features an elephant icon and discusses memory, box 2 features a trunk or elephant-face icon and discusses delicacy despite size, box 3 features a zoo building icon and discusses what can be learned at the zoo. At the bottom right, add 1 bordered summary box with a ribbon-like header reading "まとめ", a small elephant silhouette, and 2 short Japanese summary paragraphs. Along the bottom margin, include the page number "068", the date "APRIL 2025", and a row of small walking elephant silhouettes. Add subtle botanical flourishes, leaves, and light decorative strokes throughout. Overall mood: gentle, educational, heartwarming, airy, natural, child-friendly, and sophisticated, like a premium seasonal magazine feature.

During a TV interview, a caption saying "{argument name="caption" default="It's a secret❤"}" is added to the screen. The screen is a talk show layout with a picture-in-picture window in the bottom left and a time display in the top right. Configure the screen with captions like 'Breaking News' or 'Exclusive Interview'. The model girl says, 'It's a secret❤' with an appropriate pose, putting a forefinger to her mouth and winking with one eye.

items.titleZh: Create a polished vertical real-estate promotional flyer in a clean, modern social-media ad style, 4:5 poster composition. Use a bright daytime outdoor theme with a pale blue sky, soft clouds, and leafy green tree branches framing the top left and top right corners. The layout should feel like a premium property investment advertisement with bold typography, glossy marketing design, and a teal, red, white, and gray color palette. At the upper left, place a small uppercase headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="LIVE BETTER. INVEST SMARTER."}. She has a chin-length wavy bob in deep dark brown to black, delicate loose strands, soft natural texture, and a calm neutral expression. items.title: Bubble Fox Friends Meet in Niseko
items.titleZh: A bright anime-style fantasy travel scene in front of Niseko View Plaza in Hokkaido, with a clear blue sky, scattered white clouds, and a huge snow-capped mountain rising in the background. The setting is a roadside plaza parking area with a modern black-and-wood station building on the left, visible Japanese signage reading "道の駅 ニセコビュープラザ" and "Niseko View Plaza," a vertical banner reading "ようこそ ニセコへ," a tall food sign reading "名物 じゃがいも," and a dark wayfinding sign on the right reading "ニセコ Niseko" with 4 listed icons and labels: "名産品 Local Products," "農産物直売所 Farmer's Market," "レストラン Restaurant," and "情報コーナー Information." In the center, a glamorous fox-eared anime girl sits sideways atop a giant iridescent translucent soap bubble, smiling and gesturing upward with one hand. She has {argument name="hair color" default="shimmering pastel silver-lilac"} very long wavy hair, large fluffy fox ears, and a huge fluffy fox tail with rainbow-reflective highlights. Her outfit is an elaborate sparkling translucent-white and pale blue dress with holographic sheen, layered sleeves, gemstone accents, ribbons, and glossy lace-up ankle boots with bows, giving her a magical bubble-fox idol appearance. Around her float multiple smaller soap bubbles, catching rainbow light. Three fox-girl friends gather around meeting her at the plaza: 1 dark-haired fox-eared girl in a navy jacket with a Niseko patch, holding a vanilla soft-serve ice cream and looking toward the center; 1 khaki-clad fox-eared girl in an outdoor jacket and a dark cap with "HOTEL" lettering, holding a grilled corn cob; and 1 white-haired fox-eared girl in a shiny pearly hooded jacket and beret, holding a takeaway coffee cup and wearing a black backpack. Emphasize a cheerful reunion mood, travel photography composition blended with polished anime illustration, detailed environmental signage, reflective bubble surfaces, soft sunlight, crisp mountain air, and high-detail painterly rendering.

Its shell is bright {argument name="shell color" default="red"} with distinct black spots, and its body is dark charcoal black with soft rounded limbs. In the right midground, a cheerful small {argument name="second insect type" default="bee"} hovers slightly above the ground facing the larger insect, with a similarly oversized head, big sparkling eyes, delicate translucent wings, tiny antennae, and little forelegs lifted as if speaking excitedly. The setting is an enchanted bug-sized woodland hamlet with 3 visible cottages, rounded wooden doors, curved stone walls, moss, vines, flowers, and leafy plants framing the path. Warm cinematic sunlight filters through the trees from the upper right, creating glowing rim light, soft bokeh, and floating firefly-like particles. items.title: Automotive poster transformation prompt
items.titleZh:
Ultra-clean automotive poster featuring the exact same car as the photo that will be provided later. The AI must replicate the car from the uploaded photo with identical body shape, proportions, stance, color, trims, wheels, and all visible exterior details.
The car is presented in a front three-quarter angle facing right, matching the perspective of the original reference layout, but now depicted in a subtle {argument name="action" default="drifting action"}. The drift is expressed through realistic weight transfer, slight body lift, controlled smoke plumes from the rear tires, and faint curved tire marks behind the vehicle, without distorting the original car’s geometry.
Headlights follow the exact style from the reference photo of the car, with optional warm fog lights glowing if the provided car has them. All decals, emblems, plates, and window tints must match the car from the uploaded photo.
The car drifts on a glossy white reflective studio-like floor that maintains soft reflections and realistic shadows, enhanced with light drift skid reflections and directional smudges.
Background remains a clean white-to-light-gray gradient with a giant semi-transparent bold typography of the car model name (auto-extracted from the uploaded photo) vertically dominating the background.
At the very top: clean branding text “{argument name="brand name" default="CAR COMPANY NAME"}” (or the brand detected from the uploaded car photo). Under it, spaced-out stylized tracking text containing the same brand and model name.
Below the car: centered title of the exact model name from the uploaded photo.
Under that, a short descriptive paragraph about the car’s character (efficiency, style, reliability).
Bottom section shows a clean grid layout of specifications. If real specs are known from the detected car model, generate accurate values; if not, generate placeholders in the same layout style (4 columns: horsepower, 0–100 km/h, top speed, engine displacement/fuel type).
Entire poster is minimalist, editorial, high-key studio lighting with ultra-sharp reflections, crisp shadows, modern typography, and 4K believability, blending clean design with dynamic drifting energy, Ratio 9:16

items.title: Two-Page School Band Manga Spread
items.titleZh: A two-page black-and-white manga spread set in a nighttime high school band rehearsal studio, drawn in polished modern shonen/seinen manga style with detailed screentones, dramatic lighting, expressive speed lines, and glossy instrument rendering. The scene shows 4 visible band members in school uniforms: a surprised teenage boy with messy short hair at guitar and vocal mic, a calm beautiful teenage girl with very long flowing light hair playing electric guitar in the foreground, a petite long-haired teenage girl at a keyboard, and a drummer in the back whose face is intentionally obscured by a soft blur. The studio has large windows revealing a city skyline at night, hanging ceiling lights, amps including a visible Marshall stack, a drum kit with a band logo on the bass drum, cables, and a wall sign reading “Beat Box.” Compose it as a printed manga spread with 7 panels total across 2 pages, including gutters, page borders, and page numbers 13 and 14 at the bottom. Left page: 3 panels — top panel with the shocked boy turning toward the girls and a large Japanese speech bubble saying “え!?”; middle panel is a close-up of the long-haired guitarist girl with a calm expression and a Japanese speech bubble saying “……別にいいよ”; bottom panel is a wider full-band rehearsal shot with all 4 members in the studio. Right page: 4 panels — top panel is an explosive performance shot with the boy singing and playing while the long-haired girl plays guitar, with large sound-effect text “ジャッ”; middle panel is a dynamic close-up of the long-haired guitarist playing intensely, with flowing hair, musical note symbols, radiant speed lines, and the keyboard girl visible in the back; bottom panel is a close-up of the boy’s stunned face with soft bokeh and a vertical Japanese speech bubble saying “……あれ”. Emphasize the emotional contrast: awkward surprise turning into admiration as the girl’s guitar performance changes the mood. Use monochrome only, no color, authentic manga lettering, cinematic framing, layered depth, and highly detailed hair and instrument strings.

items.titleZh: A black-and-white manga two-page spread with a cinematic, melancholic tone, drawn in highly detailed seinen style with realistic lighting, wet pavement reflections, dense overhead power lines, and a star-filled night sky over a quiet Japanese residential street. The composition is divided into 4 panels total across the spread. On the left page, the top panel is a wide establishing shot of an empty suburban street at night, lined with low houses, walls, utility poles, glowing streetlights, and a slightly reflective road stretching into the distance. The bottom panel on the left page shows 1 teenage boy from behind, walking alone down the same street, wearing a dark school blazer, white shirt, loosened striped necktie, slim trousers, and carrying 1 shoulder bag slung across his back; his posture is tired and conflicted. Include 1 vertical oval Japanese speech balloon in this panel with the text 「やっぱり俺には」. On the right page, the top panel is a close-up of the boy’s hand gripping the front of his blazer or shirt near the chest in a tense gesture, with 1 hand-drawn sound effect in Japanese reading 「ギュッ…」. The bottom panel on the right page is a chest-up frontal portrait of the same boy outdoors at night, messy short light-colored hair, school uniform slightly disheveled, emotional expression, shoulder bag strap visible, background filled with soft glowing night bokeh and stars. Place 1 vertical oval Japanese speech balloon beside him reading 「でも…悔しい」. Obscure the center of his face with a flat square gray censor block. At the bottom of the right page, add 1 rectangular narration box containing the Japanese text 「才能に出会ってしまったー」. Show printed manga page layout with white gutters, page numbers 17 and 18 centered at the bottoms of the left and right pages, and a clean book-spread presentation. Keep everything grayscale, dramatic, introspective, and polished like a published manga volume.

items.title: Monochrome Manga Guitar Studio Page
items.titleZh: A black-and-white manga page spread with 5 panels on a clean white background and thin black gutters, drawn in highly detailed modern seinen/shoujo hybrid line art with soft screentones, reflective highlights, and a quiet melancholic mood. The setting is a nighttime music studio classroom with large windows showing a city skyline full of lit buildings against a dark sky. Main subject: a slender high school girl with very long straight light hair and blunt bangs, delicate features, and a serious introspective expression, wearing a Japanese school uniform consisting of a white button-up shirt, loosened striped ribbon tie, and plaid skirt, seated and playing a solid-body electric guitar that resembles a Stratocaster. In the large upper-left panel, show her in three-quarter view holding the guitar across her lap, left hand on the fretboard and right hand near the pickups, surrounded by studio equipment including 1 drum kit in the back left, 2 stacked guitar amplifiers on the right, and a wall sign reading "Beat Box" near the door. In the narrow upper-right panel, show a close-up of the guitar neck and her fretting hand, with the small vertical Japanese sound effect text "トン…". In the tall middle-right panel, show a close side-profile close-up of the girl looking down at the instrument with a pensive, almost disappointed expression, with the night city lights blurred through the window behind her. In the lower-left panel, show 1 teenage boy in a school blazer and loosened tie, seated indoors and turned slightly to the side; his face is obscured by a large soft gray rectangular censor block, and beside him is 1 vertical speech balloon containing the Japanese text "……やっぱり違う". In the lower-right panel, show a closer view of the same boy from the chest up against a soft bokeh screentone background; his face is again obscured by a large gray censor block. Add printed page numbers centered at the bottom margins: "5" under the left page and "6" under the right page. Emphasize a subtle narrative theme of realizing that the sound feels wrong, as if this is a continuation page from a dramatic school-band manga. Keep everything monochrome, polished, cinematic, and emotionally restrained.

items.title: Luxury Fashion Character Concept Poster
items.titleZh:
Create a high-resolution vertical character concept poster with a luxury pink and white aesthetic, blending elegance with edgy, modern fashion. The layout should feel like a premium magazine profile with clean sections and perfect grid alignment.

Main subject: A unique young woman (not resembling any real person), with long silky dark hair featuring subtle pink highlights. She has a confident, calm expression with a slightly mysterious aura. She wears a black and pink fusion outfit (mix of streetwear and idol fashion) with glossy textures, lace, and metallic accents. Lighting is soft but dramatic, with neon pink glow against dark tones.

Top section:
Large hero portrait on one side. On the other side, include a sleek profile panel with elegant English text:

Name: {argument name="character name" default="Nyra Vale"}
Age: {argument name="age" default="23"}
Height: {argument name="height" default="170 cm"}
Style: Dark Elegance

Short description:
“She doesn’t follow trends—she defines them. Quiet strength, sharp vision, and a presence that speaks without words.”

Add a Traits section with stylish progress bars:

Confidence
Creativity
Discipline
Charisma
Emotional Depth

Middle section:
Grid of 5–6 small portraits showing different expressions (soft smile, intense gaze, playful smirk, thoughtful, confident).

Lower sections:

Full-body poses (front, side, walking pose, power stance, casual stance).
Outfit variations (street luxe, stage outfit, minimal chic).
Accessories panel (heels, boots, chains, rings, handbags, hairstyles).

Text tone:
Strong, meaningful, and confident—focused on individuality, self-worth, and silent power. Avoid filler text.

Style:
Ultra-detailed, 4K quality, glossy magazine finish, cinematic lighting, sharp focus, balanced contrast, modern editorial layout, perfectly aligned grid.

items.title: Hidden Duck in Miniature Venice
items.titleZh: A highly detailed isometric miniature diorama illustration of a lively Venetian canal square in warm golden daylight, rendered like an ultra-cute handcrafted travel scene with chibi doll-like tourists, tiny shopfronts, textured stone pavement, flower boxes, striped awnings, and sparkling turquoise water. The composition is densely packed and whimsical, designed as a hidden-object scene titled on a decorative sign in the upper right that reads {argument name="headline text" default="Find the duck! 🐤"}. Show a charming Venice setting with a central arched stone bridge crossing a narrow canal, multiple gondolas in the water, and dozens of small travelers and locals in colorful outfits, hats, sunglasses, cameras, and shopping bags. Place a souvenir kiosk with postcards and signs, a flower stall overflowing with bright bouquets, a café terrace with red-and-white checkered tables, a carnival mask shop display, stacked vintage suitcases near the canal, striped mooring poles, laundry hanging between buildings, wrought-iron street lamps, and old pastel buildings in peach, ochre, and cream with green shutters and terracotta roofs. Include visible storefront signs reading “MASCHERE,” “CAFFÈ,” “SOUVENIRS,” “FIORI,” and “VENEZIA.” Hide exactly {argument name="duck count" default="4"} small yellow rubber ducks throughout the scene as a playful search challenge, with one especially noticeable duck perched near the stacked suitcases and the others subtly blended among the busy market details. Add one tiny fluffy white dog near the flower stall. The overall style should feel like a premium collectible toy-city illustration, richly layered, joyful, cozy, and travel-themed, with soft depth of field, crisp miniature textures, and a bustling storybook atmosphere. Use {argument name="city" default="Venice"} as the location inspiration, and make the crowd feature {argument name="character style" default="cute chibi travelers"} in varied poses such as walking, chatting, taking photos, shopping, sitting at the café, standing on the bridge, and riding in gondolas.

items.title: Surreal Clockwork Gentleman on a Gear
items.titleZh: A surreal impasto oil painting in the spirit of a late-19th-century post-impressionist masterpiece, showing a stout gentleman in a patterned golden-blue suit and tall top hat balancing awkwardly on a giant bronze gear high above a sunlit canal city. His face is obscured by a centered vertical rectangular censor block in warm brown, creating an intentional anonymous focal interruption. He wears a richly textured jacket with mosaic-like patches of ochre, cobalt, rust, and cream, matching trousers, heavy leather boots, and a waist area that opens into an exposed clockwork mechanism full of gears and ornate brass details. His body leans forward with both hands extended as if trying to keep balance, one boot planted on the gear and the other lifted slightly outward. The background is an airy blue sky with swirling painterly clouds and scattered gold brushstrokes, while below and to the left appears a historic bell tower and arched waterfront architecture, and to the right distant terracotta rooftops beside shimmering water. Use thick visible brushstrokes, luminous warm highlights, bold blue-and-gold contrast, expressive texture, and a whimsical steampunk-meets-Venetian atmosphere. Compose the figure large and central, slightly cropped by the frame, with the giant gear visible beneath him and the city receding below.

items.titleZh:
- Character: Oriental female @image_1, black high ponytail, modified Cheongsam {argument name="dress color" default="dark purple"} gown @image_2, gold vintage large hoop earrings, red lips, cold and noble temperament.
- Vehicle: @image_3 {argument name="car model" default="Huawei Zhijie R7"}, Nebula Purple paint, streamlined sedan silhouette, license plate with Chinese characters 'Zhijie R7'.

Scene: Outside a top-tier night award ceremony or international film festival venue. Marble plaza, flanked by media with long lenses and flashlights. Faraway buildings with giant light installations and a red carpet extension.

Storyboard plan, deep black high-end editorial layout, purple and gold color scheme title: "{argument name="storyboard title" default="IGNITE · Zhijie R7 × Grand Ceremony Entrance Blockbuster Project"}"

Section 1 - Character and Vehicle Reference (professional lookbook layout style): Extracting from reference images - front/side of character, full side of vehicle, close-up of front, macro of earrings and handbag.

Section 2 - Divided into left and right parts:
Left: Real scene reference for environment (night lobby atmosphere photo).
Right: Top-down spatial floor plan. Notated with: spatial outlines (stairs/plaza/aisles), initial character position + dashed path arrows, 5 camera positions (number + abbreviation), camera direction arrows, product/prop anchors, highlighted core composition areas.

5-Frame Storyboard (2.39:1 CinemaScope):
Frame 1: Long shot · Moment door opens. Night plaza in a sea of flashes, door opens, purple interior ambient light lights up first, backlit silhouette, hair and hem blowing in wind.
Frame 2: Entrance walk · Low angle shot. Looking up from ground level as she steps down in stilettos, marble reflecting the hem, Zhijie R7 body in back as a glowing backdrop, flashes bursting in distance.
Frame 3: Turn back · 85mm portrait close-up. She turns sideways, looking directly at the camera, gold earrings glint in the flash, very slight curve of the mouth, expression controlling the scene.
Frame 4: Hero shot of car and person. She stands in front of the car, breeze blowing the dress, Zhijie R7 full side glowing behind, Nebula Purple paint and gown forming a high-end chromatic harmony, background media crowd blurred.
Frame 5: Departure end shot. She enters the car, door closes slowly, taillights light up, vehicle slowly drives away from the red carpet amidst flashes, leaving only light trails.

Lighting and Style:
Strong night side-backlight · Instant flash exposure feel. Deep black background · Purple car body as one of the only light sources. 2.39:1 anamorphic wide screen · Large aperture shallow depth of field. Keywords: Absolute protagonist aura · Event-level narrative · Movie premiere quality.

items.title: Anime Shrine Maiden Omamori Counter
items.titleZh: A clean anime-style illustration of a young shrine maiden working at a traditional Japanese shrine amulet counter inside a warm wooden building. She is a single female subject shown from about waist up behind the counter, with her face obscured by a soft rectangular blur, long straight {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair tied back with a red cord and white paper zigzag shrine ornament, wearing a white kimono top and vivid {argument name="hakama color" default="red"} hakama. She is politely handing a protective charm to a visitor across the counter; only the visitor’s hands, torso, and beige jacket sleeves are visible in the foreground. The scene should feel calm, respectful, and softly lit by daylight coming through a wooden lattice window on the right, where a red torii gate and shrine grounds are visible outside in gentle blur. The interior is richly detailed with dark natural wood beams, shelves, and a small kamidana altar in the upper left decorated with 4 hanging white shide paper streamers and 2 green sakaki plants in white vases. On the right hangs a vertical sign with the Japanese text "御守・御札授与所". On the left shelves are shrine goods and signs: 3 small shelf labels reading "おみくじ", multiple stacks of paper fortunes and talismans, white drawstring bags, and upright placards including "御守", "御札", and "交通安全". The countertop is neatly arranged with 3 shallow wooden display trays of colorful omamori charms, 5 visible tabletop paper labels or stacks reading "厄除", "御守", "御札", "御朱印", and "御礼", plus a black ink pot, 2 writing brushes, a small empty wooden tray, a rectangular abacus, and bundled paper items. The charm being exchanged should be a delicate pastel omamori with floral decoration and a tied cord. Use a polished contemporary anime illustration style with fine linework, soft shading, realistic hand posing, subtle dust motes in the air, and strong emphasis on the subject and counter interaction rather than dramatic stylization.

items.titleZh: A highly detailed layered papercut diorama illustration of a deer family standing on a narrow forest path in deep winter. Show exactly 4 deer facing forward: 1 large stag with tall branching antlers positioned slightly right of center, 1 adult doe on the left, 1 smaller young deer in the middle foreground, and 1 young deer on the right. The scene is built entirely in intricate cut-paper craft style with stacked paper layers, crisp cut edges, sculpted contours, and soft dimensional shadows between layers. The animals are made from warm brown, chestnut, tan, and cream paper with delicately layered chest fur, white muzzles, alert ears, and small patches of snow resting on their heads, backs, and shoulders. Surround them with a dense winter forest of tall bare trees and fir trees, all rendered in layered paper silhouettes. Snow heavily coats the branches, bushes, rocks, and ground. Compose the trees as an enclosing corridor that frames the deer symmetrically, with the snowy path leading from the foreground into the group. Use a restrained cold palette for the environment: white, off-white, pale gray, slate gray, and charcoal, contrasted by the warm brown deer. Add subtle depth haze in the distant trees, clean studio-like lighting, and a calm storybook atmosphere. items.title: Ink-Wash Warrior Riding a Tiger
items.titleZh: A dramatic vertical Chinese ink-wash fantasy painting on warm off-white rice paper, combining monumental calligraphy with a heroic figure scene. On the right side, a lone ancient warrior in ornate dark robes and layered black armor sits astride a large tiger on the edge of a jagged cliff, both shown in three-quarter back view facing left toward the open landscape. The warrior wears a flowing cape and long ribbon streamers whipping in the wind, and raises a straight sword vertically so that it becomes a brilliant pillar of golden-white light piercing upward into dense storm clouds. The tiger is powerfully built, realistic, alert, and richly detailed with bold stripes, white fur accents, and ceremonial cloth and tack with subtle gold ornament. The sky is filled with smoky gray ink clouds, softly blooming washes, and scattered gold flecks around the glowing sword beam. Below and to the left, a misty shanshui landscape opens into distant mountains, river water, tiny tree clusters, and layered atmospheric haze rendered in pale gray ink. On the left half of the composition, include 2 large vertical columns of expressive black brush-calligraphy in Chinese, bold and irregular, occupying most of the height; add 1 narrower vertical line of smaller calligraphy beside them and 4 red seal stamps total, with 2 small seals near the smaller inscription, 1 seal near the upper right edge, and 1 double-stacked red seal at the lower left. Emphasize high contrast between empty paper space and dark ink masses, literati painting aesthetics, sweeping brush energy, epic martial grandeur, and a subtle modern fantasy finish with restrained metallic gold highlights.

items.title: Chinese Ink Warrior on Horseback
items.titleZh: A dramatic vertical Chinese ink wash painting in monochrome black, charcoal, and soft gray on off-white rice paper, in the style of expressive shan shui brush art and heroic historical wuxia illustration. On the right side, a lone armored general sits upright on a dark warhorse atop a rocky cliff, viewed from behind and slightly in profile, looking out over a vast army below. The warrior wears layered black lamellar armor, a flowing windblown cloak, and a topknot with long trailing ribbons; he holds a straight sword angled downward beside the horse. The horse is muscular and glossy black, standing firmly near the cliff edge with its tail and mane subtly swept by the wind. Below and across the lower half of the scene, a dense battlefield mass of soldiers appears as misty silhouettes with upright spears and several battle flags, partially obscured by fog. In the distance, steep mountain peaks emerge through drifting mist on the upper right, with 7 small birds flying across the pale sky near the center. On the left side, include 2 large vertical columns of bold black Chinese calligraphy in wild cursive brush strokes: the main quote reading “一身转战三千里，一剑曾当百万师”, with a smaller vertical signature “王维” below, plus a small red seal stamp. Emphasize strong negative space, textured ink bleeding, splattered brush edges, atmospheric haze, epic solitude, martial grandeur, and a solemn, contemplative mood.

A minimalist literary book cover in a refined East Asian editorial style, portrait orientation, with a warm off-white paper background and subtle grainy print texture. The composition is vertically split into 2 large abstract fields: a rough torn gray paper shape occupying the upper left half, and a deep black painted block occupying the lower left corner. Emerging from the black area is 1 stark white theatrical mask shape with a single black eye slit, cropped large and angled upward, suggesting alienation and hidden identity. At the center-bottom where the gray and white fields meet, place 1 tiny solitary human figure in a long dark coat standing on a narrow triangular ledge, facing forward, emphasizing isolation and vulnerability. From near the top center, let 1 thin red thread descend vertically with a slight waviness, ending around the middle in 1 muted red circular seal-like disc, aligned above the figure. Set 1 large vertical title in bold expressive black Chinese calligraphy on the right-center: {argument name="title text" default="人间失格"}. Add 1 small vertical Japanese reading beside it: "にんげんしっかく". Below that, add 1 short two-line Chinese phrase in black: "生而为人

2024" with a short horizontal line beneath. Use restrained negative space, asymmetrical balance, raw paper collage edges, sumi-ink and gouache textures, muted charcoal black gray and faded vermilion palette, elegant literary melancholy, premium contemporary Chinese novel cover design.

items.title: Dark Creative Overload at Night
items.titleZh: A moody cinematic digital illustration of a tired young creator sitting alone at a cluttered desk in a dark room at night, seen in three-quarter side view, leaning forward with one elbow on the desk and one hand covering part of the face in an exhausted, overwhelmed pose. The face is intentionally obscured in shadow. The person wears dark casual clothes and a lanyard badge, suggesting a student, designer, or medical worker. The room feels realistic and slightly messy, with a desk lamp, papers, sketchbooks, mugs, stationery, and stacked books. On the left wall, include 2 illuminated X-ray films and a round wall clock, plus shelves and pinned notes in deep shadow. In front of the person is a glowing widescreen monitor showing an AI image generation or creative editing interface with a city-at-sunset artwork in the main preview and a row of thumbnail variations beneath it, modern dark UI, one purple action button. The monitor is the main light source, casting warm orange and cool blue highlights across the desk. Around the monitor and pouring out into the air, depict a vast surreal explosion of imagination and digital creativity: a swirling galaxy-like vortex with stars, nebula colors, spark particles, light trails, and cosmic dust in purple, blue, pink, and gold. Embed many floating dreamlike elements inside the swirl: a fantasy castle on a floating island with a tree, planets and moons, an astronaut, a film clapperboard, a video camera, musical notes, glowing silhouettes of people, a futuristic city skyline, a hot-air balloon, a car, birds, jellyfish-like luminous creatures, and multiple cats, including 1 giant sleeping orange tabby cat in the upper right and 1 cat in a space helmet near the lower right. The magical imagery should feel like thoughts escaping from the computer, beautiful but slightly dark and overwhelming, as if creativity, obsession, and emotional intensity are filling the room. Include a skeletal anatomy hand model standing beside the monitor on the right side of the desk, reinforcing an art-studio or study setting. Use dramatic low-key lighting, high contrast, intricate detail, volumetric glow, cinematic depth, and a balance of realism and fantastical surrealism. The overall mood is melancholic, imaginative, and darkly inspiring, visualizing the feeling of being consumed by ideas generated through {argument name="creative tool" default="AI image generation"}.

items.title: Xinjiang Road Trip Scrapbook Spread
items.titleZh: A warm, handcrafted travel scrapbook spread photographed from directly above on a wooden tabletop, showing an open two-page journal with thick deckled paper edges and layered fabric tabs peeking out from the sides. The style is a realistic mixed-media travel diary with watercolor map art, handwritten Chinese titles, taped instant photos, doodles, and soft natural light. On the upper left page, write the date "2024.09.20." in small handwriting and a large black brush-style Chinese title reading {argument name="title text" default="新疆公路旅行手帐"}. Arrange 5 Polaroid-style instant photos across the spread, each slightly tilted and attached with beige or patterned washi tape: 1 photo at upper left showing two travelers by a blue alpine lake labeled "天山天池"; 1 tall photo near upper center-left showing three people on a green grassland labeled "那拉提草原"; 1 photo at lower left showing a couple by a deep blue lake labeled "赛里木湖"; 1 photo at upper center-right showing two travelers on a long empty road under a bright blue sky labeled "沙漠公路"; 1 photo at lower center showing two figures standing on dunes at sunset labeled "日落沙丘". Add small handwritten bilingual place annotations near the left-page photos: "天山天池 (Tianshan Tianchi)", "赛拉木草原 (Sayram Lake)", "沙漠公路 (Desert Highway)", and "日落沙丘 (Sunset Dunes)" in a casual notebook style. On the right page, paint a loose watercolor map of Xinjiang in beige, pale green, and blue, with a bold winding blue road route crossing the region and exactly 10 red location pins placed along the route. Include map doodles: a small mountain icon cluster near the top, a river and several blue lakes, a tiny compass in the upper right, 2 camel drawings, 2 yurt drawings, and thin gray roads branching around the main blue route. Along the bottom of the right page, place 3 more taped Polaroid photos: 1 at lower left showing people in colorful ethnic clothing labeled "大巴扎"; 1 at lower middle showing hands holding grilled meat skewers labeled "烤肉串"; 1 at lower right showing a couple inside a yurt labeled "蒙古包自拍". Scatter small hand-drawn doodles throughout both pages, including a sun, a tiny car, 2 horse drawings, 4 fish icons, a crescent moon, several stars, small arrows, flames near the food photo and along the lower map area, and tiny decorative swirls. Keep all text in Chinese where shown, with a lively hand-journal aesthetic, realistic paper texture, slight shadows under every photo, and an overall cozy memory-book feeling of a Xinjiang road trip.

items.title: Cyberpunk Fashion Campaign Poster
items.titleZh:
Ultra-realistic luxury fashion campaign poster featuring a young male model with textured wavy hair, sharp jawline, and minimal beard, wearing slim futuristic visor glasses. He stands in a composed yet powerful pose, slightly turned, eyes locked with the camera.

Outfit: oversized matte-finish charcoal techwear trench coat with layered panels, magnetic closures, and subtle reflective piping. Inner layer includes a high-neck tactical knit and structured cargo trousers, creating a futuristic urban silhouette.

Branding elements: subtle co-branded identity of {argument name="brands" default="Acronym × Adidas Originals"} placed minimally on coat sleeve and top corner of composition. Add small futuristic patches, barcodes, and geometric tech symbols for a clean cyber aesthetic.

Composition: medium shot, slightly low angle for dominance, coat flowing and occupying most of the frame with strong structure and depth. Model positioned slightly off-center.

Background: dark gradient concrete wall with neon cyan and white holographic-style typography behind the subject, slightly defocused for depth.

Lighting: cinematic high-contrast lighting with cool cyan and teal tones, combined with a sharp white rim light outlining the coat edges. Subtle reflections enhance the fabric’s technical texture. HDR, ultra-sharp focus, premium editorial finish.

Typography layout:
• Top right: co-branded logos
• Left vertical block: technical product specs text
• Right side: minimal tagline “{argument name="tagline" default="Engineered for the unseen"}”
• Bottom: “{argument name="label" default="Urban Tech Capsule"}” label

Style: futuristic streetwear campaign, cyberpunk editorial, ultra-detailed, 8k resolution, shallow depth of field, soft film grain, clean yet bold composition, modern UI-inspired overlays

items.title: Moonlit Yuri Wedding Poster
items.titleZh: A romantic fantasy wedding illustration of two women standing arm in arm in a moonlit palace balcony at night, highly detailed anime style with luminous painterly rendering, elegant and dreamy. The taller woman on the left has {argument name="left character hair color" default="light brown"} shoulder-length softly layered hair and wears a regal ivory-white tailored wedding suit with gold embroidery, a high-collared ruffled shirt, cream vest, cravat, chain accessories, and a long ceremonial coat whose inner lining is deep violet with floral patterns; a purple flower corsage is pinned to her chest. The woman on the right has {argument name="right character hair color" default="black"} long wavy hair and wears an ornate bridal gown in ivory with gold lace embroidery, sheer lace sleeves, a fitted bodice, a very long translucent veil, and rich crimson inner panels and accents peeking from the skirt; she wears red gemstone jewelry and floral hair ornaments in white and red. She holds a large bouquet of red, burgundy, and white flowers with greenery and trailing red ribbons while gently linking arms with her partner. Set them before gothic arched windows, hanging crystal ornaments, glowing lanterns, purple flowers, a distant city skyline, a star-filled sky, and a bright full moon. Add decorative vertical Japanese title text integrated into the composition: on the left, {argument name="left title text" default="紫苑の護り"} with smaller vertical ruby text beside it; on the right, {argument name="right title text" default="紅雪の献心"} with smaller vertical ruby text beside it. Include crescent moon and snowflake-like decorative motifs framing the titles. Use a tall poster composition, full-body view, luxurious fabrics, sparkling highlights, soft bokeh, and an overall palette of ivory, gold, violet, crimson, and midnight blue.

items.title: Romantic Yuri Wedding Chapel Portrait
items.titleZh: A luminous, ultra-detailed anime-style wedding portrait of two brides in a romantic white chapel filled with soft ivory light, sheer curtains, carved arches, pale floral arrangements, and sparkling bokeh. The composition is vertical and elegant, showing the pair from about thigh-up to full dress detail, standing close together in an intimate yuri moment. The taller bride on the left has {argument name="hair color" default="warm chestnut brown"} long wavy hair cascading over her shoulders and back, wearing a refined white bridal pantsuit with a fitted tailcoat, gold buttons, a cream vest, a silk cravat, subtle floral embroidery along the coat tails, and a white rose boutonniere with pale blue accents. She is visibly emotional, gently wiping tears with a handkerchief, her other hand resting near her chest, giving the feeling of being moved by the ceremony. The shorter bride on the right has {argument name="second bride hair color" default="long black hair"}, very long and glossy, and wears an ornate off-shoulder wedding gown in white with icy blue undertones, translucent lace sleeves, intricate beadwork, floral embroidery, layered ruffles, and a long veil decorated with tiny flowers and crystal-like details. A silver floral hair ornament with dangling pieces decorates the side of her head. She looks up at her partner tenderly while holding a cascading bouquet of white roses, blue flowers, and trailing greenery. Emphasize the contrast between the tailored princely suit and the delicate fairy-tale gown, with luxurious fabric textures, lace transparency, fine embroidery, soft glowing highlights, drifting sparkles, and a dreamy, emotional atmosphere. Make the scene feel like {argument name="relationship theme" default="an original yuri wedding between an older office lady-style bride and a younger nurse-style bride"}, painted in polished, high-end romantic illustration style, ethereal, graceful, and heartfelt.

items.title: Celestial Yuri Wedding in Moonlit Cathedral
items.titleZh: A lavish fantasy yuri wedding illustration in a highly detailed anime style, full-body portrait of two brides walking arm in arm down the aisle in a celestial cathedral at night. The left bride is a tall, elegant androgynous woman with {argument name="left character hair color" default="warm brown"} hair in a long thick side braid over one shoulder, wearing an aristocratic white wedding suit with fitted trousers, heeled white boots, a ruffled cravat, layered gold chains, embroidered gold filigree, floral corsage, and a dramatic long white coat lined in deep midnight blue like a starry sky. The right bride is a graceful woman with {argument name="right character hair color" default="silver white"} very long flowing wavy hair, a jeweled tiara, and a sheer veil, wearing an opulent {argument name="wedding dress style" default="voluminous white celestial lace ball gown"} with translucent layered sleeves, intricate silver embroidery, star and moon motifs, sparkling beadwork, and tiny red gemstone accents cascading down the skirt. She holds a {argument name="bouquet flowers" default="white lily and rose bouquet"}. Their expressions are serene and romantic, posed close together as if proceeding during the ceremony. The setting is a glowing moonlit gothic chapel with towering ornate arches, stained-glass-like tracery, hanging banners, candles, white floral arrangements, and celestial decorations. items.title: Concept to Form Design Process
items.titleZh:
Subject: [e.g., {argument name="subject" default="Tennis Serve"}] 
Please present the transformation process of this theme from concept to form, as well as the completed design as the final result, in an A4 vertical visual image. Two-part structure (top and bottom). 
The top section is a five-step visualization flowchart of the essence of the theme: Source of Inspiration → Trajectory & Energy → Abstracted Lines & Structure → Three-dimensional Form → Final Design. Build it according to this flow. Fine sketches, line drawings, design blueprints, small arrows, short English labels, and a layout with elegant negative space. 
The title is "MOTION TO FORM." 
The bottom image displays the final 'hero visual' image formed from the process above. The category is not fixed; the AI chooses the most suitable design object based on the theme. It can be any form, such as a product, object, furniture, accessory, packaging, vessel, lamp, gadget, accessory, artwork, etc. 
Generate a fictional brand name, slogan, and short copy to create creative content suitable for advertising or design release visual effects. 
The overall presentation has a high level of completion, merging concept boards, brand advertisements, and design development materials. A sense of beauty composed of minimalism, poetry, intelligence, and negative space. The color palette is based on neutral tones, paired with 1-2 accent colors derived from the theme. 
Accurately depict material feel, light, shadow, structural beauty, and texture representation. High resolution, commercial-grade visual quality.

She wears a premium black and {argument name="color scheme" default="hot-pink"} baseball cap featuring bold, glowing {argument name="accent color" default="hot-pink"} 3D lettering “{argument name="name" default="SHARON"}” on the front, designed like a high-end streetwear brand logo. items.title: Luxury Concept Poster Design
items.titleZh:
What you will generate is not a regular illustration, but a high-end concept poster that expresses the meaning and symbolism of the person and name "{argument name="person name" default="ELON MUSK"}" as a visual metaphor.

Place the giant letters "{argument name="person name" default="ELON MUSK"}" as the main protagonist of the entire screen. The letters should be thick, powerful sans-serif characters with an overwhelming presence. The background should be {argument name="background color" default="deep black"}, and the characters a slightly yellowish off-white, with paper texture, graininess, and light scuffs like vintage silkscreen printing or old posters.

At the bottom center, place a monochrome portrait of a man reminiscent of Elon Musk. It should have an atmosphere similar to the person himself, with an expression looking up at the future. The face should not be too realistic, but expressed with strong shadows in a print/poster style.

In the upper right, include a composition where a rocket is launching diagonally upward. Use {argument name="accent color" default="red"} as an accent color for the rocket's exhaust flames and smoke, and have it pass through the giant letters as if cutting through them. This visualizes the meaning of "breaking through to the future," "breaking through existing frameworks," and "large-scale challenges."

Make the overall design a minimalist and powerful graphic poster. Do not add too many elements; compose it only with the text, the person, the rocket, and the red smoke. The composition should be bold and designed to leave an impression at a glance, even from a distance.

In the lower left, add small auxiliary text like "VISION / SCALE / MOTION," and in the lower right, "BUILD THE FUTURE." You may discreetly place small symbols associated with Tesla or X if necessary, but the main focus remains the symbolism of the name "ELON MUSK" and the person.

Unify the colors around three main colors: black, off-white, and red. Create a concept poster with a strong visual memory that conveys luxury, futurism, ambition, solitude, a sense of scale, and the energy of destruction and creation.
items.prompt:
あなたが生成するのは、普通のイラストではなく、「{argument name="人物名" default="ELON MUSK"}」という人物・名前が持つ意味や象徴性を、視覚的なメタファーとして表現した高級コンセプトポスターです。

巨大な文字「{argument name="人物名" default="ELON MUSK"}」を画面全体の主役として配置してください。文字は太く、力強く、圧倒的な存在感を持つサンセリフ体。背景は{argument name="背景色" default="深い黒"}、文字は少し黄味がかったオフホワイトで、ヴィンテージのシルクスクリーン印刷や古いポスターのような紙質感、粒子感、軽い擦れを加えてください。

画面中央下には、イーロン・マスクを想起させる男性のモノクロポートレートを配置してください。本人に似た雰囲気で、未来を見上げるような表情。顔は写実的すぎず、版画・ポスター調の強い陰影で表現してください。

右上には、ロケットが斜め上に打ち上がっていく構図を入れてください。ロケットの噴射炎と煙は{argument name="アクセントカラー" default="赤"}をアクセントカラーにし、巨大な文字の一部を切り裂くように通過させてください。これにより「未来へ突き抜ける」「既存の枠を突破する」「スケールの大きな挑戦」という意味を視覚化します。

全体は極簡で力強いグラフィックポスターにしてください。要素を増やしすぎず、文字、人物、ロケット、赤い噴煙だけで構成します。構図は大胆で、遠くから見ても一目で印象に残るデザインにしてください。

左下に小さく「VISION / SCALE / MOTION」、右下に「BUILD THE FUTURE.」のような短い補助テキストを入れてください。必要に応じてTeslaやXを連想させる小さな記号を控えめに配置してもよいですが、主役はあくまで「ELON MUSK」という文字と人物の象徴性です。

色数は黒、オフホワイト、赤の3色を中心に統一してください。高級感、未来感、野心、孤独、スケール感、破壊と創造のエネルギーが伝わる、強い視覚記憶を持つコンセプトポスターにしてください。

items.title: 1960s Art-House Film Poster
items.titleZh:
Create a vertical poster composition on aged cream paper with a handmade analog feel. Use rough ripped paper edges, layered magazine cutouts, photocopy grain, halftone texture, ink bleed, and slightly imperfect screen-print registration. Keep the subject as the main black-and-white photographic portrait, placed prominently in the center or upper center.

Surround the subject with graphic blocks of deep red, cobalt blue, warm yellow, black, and ivory. Add supporting collage fragments such as a rainy European street, film-strip borders, newspaper clippings, urban silhouettes, and cinematic details, arranged like a handmade 1960s art-house movie poster.

Use bold condensed typography with a strong visual hierarchy. Add large headline text: “{argument name="main title" default="[MAIN TITLE]"}”. Add smaller subtitle text: “{argument name="subtitle" default="[SUBTITLE]"}”. Add bottom text: “{argument name="event details" default="[BRAND NAME / EVENT NAME / COMING SOON / DATE]"}”. If needed, include a small top line reading “[TAGLINE]”.

The final result should feel cinematic, intellectual, rebellious, and editorial — like a lost 1960s European film poster with a strong point of view. Keep it raw, tactile, printed, imperfect, and handmade. Avoid a glossy modern finish.

items.title: Raiden Shogun Beach Cosplay Cover
items.titleZh: Create a high-fashion magazine cover photo of a glamorous beach cosplay portrait inspired by Raiden Shogun from Genshin Impact. A single adult woman sits on a large dark seaside rock in a three-quarter front pose, one hand resting behind her on the rock and the other relaxed near her side, with one thigh raised prominently toward the camera. Her face is intentionally obscured by a soft rectangular blur censor centered over the face. She has very long, rich violet-purple hair with magenta highlights, styled with a thick braid draped over one shoulder and loose windswept strands flowing to the right, decorated with blue flower hair ornaments and gold accessories near one side of the head. She wears an elegant lavender, lilac, and deep purple Raiden Shogun-style cosplay outfit: a low-cut kimono-inspired bodice, translucent flowing sleeves, layered sash and obi with ornate circular gold-and-purple emblem at the waist, a jeweled choker with a purple gem, dangling blue-and-gold earrings, a black armored-looking forearm piece, and sheer purple thigh-high stockings with garter straps and decorative patterns. The lighting is natural golden beach daylight with soft highlights on skin and fabric, shallow depth of field, and a luxurious editorial look. The background is a softly blurred shoreline with pale sand, shimmering water, sea mist, and a distant rocky island or cliff. Compose it as a full magazine cover with elegant fashion typography in dark royal purple. The masthead is huge across the top reading {argument name="magazine title" default="COSPLAY"}, with small top-left text "COSPLAY REALM MAGAZINE" and small top-right text "JANUARY 2024". Add left-side cover lines: "RAIDEN SHOGUN", "COSPLAY BY SAKURA", "BEHIND THE SCENES AT THE BEACH", and "EXCLUSIVE INTERVIEW" followed by smaller text "Sakura talks about her love for Genshin Impact". Add right-side cover lines: "GENSHIN IMPACT" with smaller text "SPECIAL EDITION", and at lower right "TOP COSER OF 2024" with smaller text "Sakura’s rise to stardom". Place a realistic barcode with small pricing text in the bottom-left corner. Overall style: ultra-realistic cosplay photography, glossy magazine cover design, cinematic, sensual but tasteful, premium fashion editorial, high detail fabrics and accessories, sharp subject with softly blurred ocean background.

items.titleZh: A manga-style character profile page in the dramatic visual language of a supernatural battle comic, printed on a slightly aged beige paper background with black ink outlines, dense hatching, and high-contrast cel shading. The composition features 3 main sections: a left information panel, a central full-body female character portrait, and a right-side humanoid stand figure with vertical Japanese dialogue text. In the center, depict a tall, athletic young Japanese woman, about {argument name="character age" default="22"} years old, with long straight {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair, tan healthy skin, and a muscular sporty physique. Her face is completely obscured by a large rectangular mosaic censor blur. She wears 3 visible outfit pieces: a tight white sweat-soaked tank top, very short dark navy athletic shorts with a drawstring, and no visible accessories. Her skin and clothes glisten with sweat, emphasizing a humid, sensual, intense training vibe. She stands in a confident forward-facing pose with one arm lowered toward the viewer, creating a slightly foreshortened perspective. Behind and to her right, show a sleek humanoid stand entity made of glossy pale lavender liquid with splashing droplets around its head and shoulders, narrow eyes, smooth organic armor-like anatomy, and 3 round purple orb details down the chest and abdomen. Add 2 large stylized purple Japanese sound effects in a hand-drawn manga font: one near the top reading "ゴゴゴ…" and one near the lower body reading "ゴゴゴゴ……". On the far right, place a vertical Japanese exclamation in black text: "オラオララッ！汗の一滴まで見逃されェ！". The left panel is a boxed black-on-beige character dossier with multiple horizontal dividers and Japanese text. Include these profile fields exactly as visible: "スタンド使い名:" followed by "{argument name="character name" default="水沢 咲良"}（ミズサワ サクラ）", "性別:" followed by "女", "見た目:" followed by "黒髪ロング、健康的な体つき スポーティな服装が多い", "年齢:" followed by "22歳", "身長:" followed by "160cm", and "職業:" followed by "フリーター ジムトレーナー". Below that, include a boxed radar chart titled "スタンド能力パラメーター" with 6 labeled stats around the graph: "破壊力 B", "スピード A", "射程距離 C", "成長性 B", "精密動作性 A", and durability at the remaining axis, with a purple filled polygon. At the bottom left, include another boxed text section with the stand name and ability description. The stand section should read: "スタンド名:" then "『{argument name="stand name" default="SWEAT BLOOM"}』" and below it "（スウェット・ブルーム）". Under "スタンドの能力:" include a dense Japanese paragraph describing a close-range stand activated by sweat and bodily fluids, able to manipulate surrounding moisture and alter the pressure and viscosity of liquids, dull an opponent's movement through sweat, make surfaces slippery to disrupt balance, and launch sweat like bullets at high speed. Overall style: gritty serialized manga splash page, dynamic sensual action-character design, JoJo-inspired exaggeration, clean page layout, detailed anatomy, purple accent color for stand effects and chart fill, no modern UI elements, full-page illustration.
