items.titleZh: A full-page manga-style parody character profile illustration on an aged off-white paper background, designed like a JoJo-inspired stand user sheet with bold ink lines, cross-hatching, dramatic posing, and stylized Japanese text. The central figure is an anthropomorphic duck mascot athlete standing in a confident forward stride, pointing directly at the viewer with one gloved hand and clenching the other fist. He has a large round pale-yellow duck head with a bright orange beak, huge glossy black eyes, and a fierce determined expression with furrowed brows. His body is human-like and athletic, wearing a dark green sleeveless soccer jersey over a white undershirt, white shorts, black shoes with teal laces, and yellow-and-black horizontal striped knee-high socks. Around his neck hangs a lanyard with an ID badge showing a small portrait icon of the duck mascot and the text “No.001”. The jersey has 4 visible sponsor-style patches and labels: “農協牛乳”, “今野硝子工業”, “相模福祉村”, and a small crest marked “SC'S”. Behind him stands his humanoid Stand, a tall muscular armored figure with a metallic olive-gold body, a heart-shaped chest emblem, narrow intimidating eyes, and a raised fist, surrounded by jagged purple spiritual flames. Add 4 large purple manga sound effect texts around the figures, each reading “ゴゴ…”, with one near the upper left of the Stand and 3 stacked vertically along the left side of the mascot. On the left side of the page, include a profile text column with 6 horizontal rule-separated lines of Japanese text: “スタンド使い名: ガミティ”, “性別: 男”, “見た目: ダチョウのマスコット”, “年齢: 不明”, “身長: 175cm”, and “職業: マスコット / PR活動”. On the right side, place a large spiky speech bubble filled with bold vertical Japanese text: “オラオラオラオラオラ！ 前に出るぞ！絶対に負けねェーッ！ 相模原・共に行こうぜェーッ！”. Below that, add a lower-right information block with a heading “スタンド名:『オオサガミ・オオオォ！』” and a smaller subtitle “(SC相模原チャント「オオサガミオオオォー！」より)”, followed by a paragraph headed “スタンド能力:” describing an emotional amplification power in dense Japanese body text. In the lower left corner, include a purple-filled radar chart with 6 axes labeled in Japanese: “破壊力 B”, “スピード B”, “射程距離 D”, “成長性 C”, “精密動作性 C”, and “持続力 C”. Composition should feel like a dramatic manga magazine character introduction page, with the mascot in front, the Stand looming behind, strong foreshortening, dynamic comic-book energy, and a humorous contrast between a cute sports mascot and an overwhelmingly serious supernatural battle presentation.

items.title: Japanese Summer Sports Drink Poster
items.titleZh:
A photorealistic Japanese summer beverage advertisement poster in a tall vertical layout, designed like an official sports drink campaign. Show a full-body teenage schoolgirl standing outdoors on a sunny hilltop road overlooking a coastal town and the ocean under a vivid blue sky with large white clouds. She is centered slightly left, posed confidently with one leg relaxed, looking off into the distance, holding a clear plastic bottle of {argument name="drink brand" default="POCARI SWEAT"} in her right hand near shoulder height. She wears a classic Japanese sailor school uniform: 1 white short-sleeve sailor blouse, 1 navy sailor collar with white stripes, 1 large navy neckerchief bow, 1 navy pleated skirt to the knees, 2 white knee-high socks, and 2 dark navy or black loafers. Her hair is long, straight, and black with a glossy sheen. Bright midday lighting, crisp shadows, fresh clean atmosphere, high realism, commercial poster finish.

Use a strong brand-forward composition. In the top left, place a large bold white logo reading "ION SUPPLY DRINK" above oversized {argument name="main logo text" default="POCARI SWEAT"} with a white wave shape beneath it. In the top right, add a small white corporate mark and the text {argument name="company name" default="Otsuka"}. On the right side, set a vertical Japanese headline in dark blue reading {argument name="headline text" default="渇いたからだに、水よりうれしい。"}. In the lower left, add a Japanese body copy block in blue, including a larger subheading and several smaller lines of explanatory text, styled like authentic ad copy. Near that text, include 1 white circular information badge with blue Japanese text and 2 small inner circles labeled "水分" and "イオン" joined by a plus sign. At the very bottom left, add small blue recycling-related fine print and iconography; at the bottom right, add the website URL {argument name="website" default="www.pocarisweat.jp"}. Make the overall design feel like a believable premium Japanese poster for a refreshing ion supply drink, suitable as a desktop wallpaper.

items.title: Old Shanghai Fusion Poster
items.titleZh: A vertical cultural travel poster on warm off-white textured paper, designed like a handcrafted 3D shadow-box collage that forms the silhouette of the Chinese character for Shanghai. Use a refined old-meets-new Shanghai theme with miniature architecture, street scenes, props, food, and typography, photographed straight-on with soft studio lighting and delicate drop shadows. The composition should feel elegant, editorial, nostalgic, and premium, with muted cream, brass gold, teal green, brick red, jade, and weathered wood tones. At the upper left, build the top section of the character from 1 modern glass skyscraper, 1 tall historic high-rise with a golden crown, 1 domed neoclassical waterfront building, 1 clock-tower civic building, 2 smaller background towers, 2 red vintage Shanghai trams, and 1 rickshaw. Beneath that, create a canal-town section with 2 tall red Oriental Pearl Tower spheres-and-columns motifs, 2 qipao dresses displayed vertically, 4 old shikumen and lane houses, 1 curved waterfront canal, 4 wooden boats on the water, and 2 gramophones placed at the far left and right edges. Across the center, place a large diagonal metallic-gold embossed title reading {argument name="headline text" default="SHANGHAI COLLECTION"} in bold retro 3D lettering. To the right of the upper composition, add hand-lettered vintage script text reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="OLD SHANGHAI FUSION"}. On the lower left, add serif text reading {argument name="tagline text" default="DESIGN POSTER"}. The lower half should form the rest of the character using traditional Chinese architectural miniatures and market objects: 1 large classical Chinese roofed building complex, 4 vertical neon-style shop signs with Chinese characters, 2 square decorative plaques, 1 small green ceramic ewer, 2 shallow food trays, 1 rectangular tray of 6 soup dumplings, 1 long tray with 3 white tanghulu-like skewered sweets, 2 round mooncakes, and 1 small sauce dish, 1 rectangular display shelf containing 4 steamed buns, 1 bowl of noodles, 2 golden pastries, 1 plate of white flower-shaped sweets, 1 small doll figurine, and 2 painted opera masks, plus 2 hanging newspapers at the lower right. Keep the background spacious and minimal, with the collage and text arranged diagonally for a sophisticated poster layout. Make the whole image look like a meticulously assembled handmade paper-and-wood diorama, combining Art Deco Shanghai glamour, Republican-era nostalgia, Jiangnan water-town charm, and traditional Chinese market culture.

items.title: Beijing Cultural Heritage Poster
items.titleZh: A refined vertical cultural exhibition poster on a warm ivory textured paper background, designed with abundant negative space and an elegant museum-catalog aesthetic. The centerpiece is one monumental piece of Chinese calligraphy formed as sculptural 3D architectural typography, reading {argument name="main Chinese character" default="北京"} as two large interconnected characters built entirely from miniature Beijing heritage landmarks and traditional decorative elements. The strokes are constructed like carved lacquer and wood architectural fragments in rich vermilion red, aged gold, jade green, turquoise blue, stone gray, and ivory, with exquisite relief detail, soft shadows, and a handcrafted collectible feel. Across the calligraphy, integrate iconic Beijing imagery: palace roofs with glazed tiles, temple pavilions, stairways, carved balustrades, watchtowers, a winding section of the Great Wall, ornamental clouds, guardian lion sculptures, small old trees, golden ginkgo branches and leaves, hanging red lanterns, a Beijing opera mask, a skewer of glossy candied hawthorn, the Temple of Heaven, and a plated roast duck tucked into one lower stroke. Make the composition feel like a cultural miniature world embedded inside each brushstroke, with realistic depth, crisp surface detail, and subtle museum lighting from the upper left. Add sparse typography around the main artwork in a sophisticated editorial layout: at upper left, a tiny emblem and the words "BEIJING CHINA", beneath it "2024" and "CITY CULTURE SERIES" in small thin serif capitals; at upper right, a vertical Chinese title reading "北京 一座城的壮阔史诗" with several smaller vertical lines of Chinese copy and a red seal stamp; at lower left, large elegant serif text reading {argument name="city name in English" default="BEIJING"} and beneath it {argument name="subtitle" default="ETERNAL GLORY"}, followed by smaller text "EXHIBITION POSTER", "NO.2024-001", and tiny heritage-themed footer copy; at lower right, tiny small-cap text reading {argument name="tagline" default="TIMELESS HERITAGE"} and "CULTURAL LEGACY OF A THOUSAND YEARS". Keep the overall style luxurious, poetic, highly detailed, and premium, blending Chinese traditional culture, architectural miniature art, and contemporary poster design.

items.title: Anime Folding Bike Event Poster
items.titleZh:
A bright, cheerful anime-style promotional poster for a folding bike cycling event, designed like a polished Japanese advertisement with dense typography, stickers, callouts, and event info panels. The scene shows a sunny riverside promenade under a vivid blue sky with fluffy clouds, green tree branches framing the top right, flower beds, bunting, drifting petals, and a distant modern city skyline across the water. In the foreground, a cute teen/young adult anime girl with {argument name="hair color" default="light chestnut brown"} shoulder-length wavy hair, side-swept bangs, and two colorful hairpins smiles directly at the viewer and winks with one eye. She is posed in dynamic perspective, reaching one hand toward the camera as if inviting the viewer to join her. She wears a yellow hooded windbreaker, a white T-shirt printed with colorful bicycle lettering, dark blue shorts, black thigh-high stockings, and a light blue backpack. Beside her is a mint-green compact folding bicycle labeled "FOLDY," shown unfolded and parked on the promenade with visible small wheels, frame hinge, handlebars, saddle, pedals, and kickstand, emphasizing portability and urban leisure cycling. Use a glossy, high-saturation anime poster aesthetic with clean linework, soft facial rendering, energetic lighting, and playful graphic decoration.

Fill the poster with Japanese ad-style layout elements. At the top left, a huge multicolored headline reads "Let’s FOLDING RIDE!" in oversized playful bubble and block lettering, with a smaller curved Japanese line above it reading "さあ、いっしょに出かけよう！" and a blue ribbon-like subtitle below reading "フォールディングバイクで、もっと自由に、もっと遠くへ！". At the upper right, place a yellow burst badge with a tiny flag icon containing the text "フォールディングバイク サイクリングイベント 開催！". Add a white speech bubble near the girl’s face with pink outline and handwritten-feel Japanese text: "ねえ、キミ！ 折りたたみは どこへでも行けるよ♪ 一緒に 行こっ！". Near the bicycle, include a small angled sticker with text "コンパクトにたためて 持ち運びラクラク♪". Near the lower center-left, add a section label "イベントの楽しみポイント♪" followed by exactly 4 round icon features in pastel circles: 1) a pink bicycle icon with text "折りたたみで 持ち運び自由！" 2) a blue camera icon with text "フォトスポットで 思い出を残そう！" 3) a yellow drink icon with text "カフェタイムで ほっとひと息♪" 4) a purple gift icon with text "オリジナルグッズ プレゼント！".

On the lower right, add a rounded white information card with green accents titled "FOLDING BIKE サイクリングイベント" and large pink date text "6.15(日)". Inside the card, present exactly 4 event detail rows with colored circular icons: 1) calendar row: "開催日 2025. ※雨天時は6.22(日)に順延" 2) location row: "集合所 みなとみらい 臨港パーク" with smaller note "(神奈川県横浜市)" 3) course row: "コース みなとみらい〜湾沿いの気持ちいいルートを走ります" with smaller note "(約20km、初心者安心！)" 4) fee row: "参加費 3,000円" with smaller note "(保険・記念品付き) ※レンタルバイクあり（要予約）". At the bottom of this card, add a pink strip reading "初心者歓迎！ひとり参加も大歓迎！". Along the very bottom of the poster, create a wide pink banner with large Japanese copy "さあ、次の休日は一緒に走ろう！" and smaller text on the left "お申し込み・詳細は公式サイトへ！". In the center-bottom place a search-bar style box containing {argument name="search text" default="フォールディングライド 2025"}. To its right, add a black-and-white QR code and a pink label reading "エントリーはこちらから！". In the bottom-right corner, include a small inset photo-style illustration of two cyclists riding together with a handwritten note "たのしいかも♡". Maintain a lively, magazine-quality event poster composition with exactly 1 main character, 1 folding bike, 1 large event info card, 1 speech bubble, 1 yellow burst badge, 1 angled portability sticker, 4 feature icons, 1 QR code, and 1 inset image.

items.title: Dance Choreography Instruction Sheet
items.titleZh:
Dance Sequence Instruction Sheet
[VISUAL STYLE]
A composition featuring a highly detailed 3D-rendered female dancer. Designed like a professional choreography guide with a technical, diagram-inspired layout. Clean white background, soft studio lighting, and strong contrast to highlight body movement and posture.
[GRID LAYOUT]
Structured 4×4 panel grid (16 frames total), evenly spaced with thin black divider lines. Each panel is identical in size and clearly numbered from 1 to 16 to show a continuous dance progression.
[CHARACTER]
Use {argument name="reference" default="image1"} as the base character. The same female dancer appears consistently across all panels with accurate likeness and proportions.
[WARDROBE]
The dancer wears a stylish, performance-ready outfit: a {argument name="clothing" default="well-fitted top paired with a short, flowy skirt"}. The look should feel modern and visually appealing while still practical for dance movement. Fabric should subtly respond to motion (slight flow and folds), even in grayscale.
[PANEL STRUCTURE – EACH FRAME]
Top-left: Step number + short dance move title (e.g., “Step 5 – Spin Transition”)
Center: Full-body pose capturing a precise moment in the choreography
Bottom-left: 3–4 lines of concise instruction describing the move
Overlay: Motion arrows and directional guides illustrating how the dancer transitions
[MOTION INDICATORS]
Incorporate curved arrows for fluid motion, straight arrows for directional steps, and circular indicators for spins or turns. Emphasize rhythm, weight shifts, and body isolation.
[RENDER QUALITY]
High-detail sculpted 3D style with smooth grayscale shading, subtle shadows, and clean linework. Maintain a polished, concept-art level finish with clarity in every pose.
[RESTRICTIONS]
No color, no background scenery, no extra characters, no visual clutter, only the dancer and instructional elements..

[RESTRICTIONS]
No color, no background scenery, no extra characters, no visual clutter, only the dancer and instructional elements..

items.titleZh:
A dynamic, vertical advertising poster for {argument name="product" default="Nike Joggers"} featuring {argument name="celebrity" default="Sydney Sweeney"} in a mid-air jump pose. Sydney Sweeney is smiling brightly with her blonde hair flowing dynamically, wearing a vibrant, color-blocked outfit: an {argument name="outfit colors" default="orange and purple"} patterned windbreaker over a blue hoodie with a yellow and pink "NIKE" logo. She wears black athletic leggings with mesh panels and a large, padded, multi-colored (orange, purple, green, blue) leg sleeve on her left leg that matches the jacket. Her footwear is prominent: a massive, highly detailed, chunky Nike M2K Tekno sneaker in white with bold orange, blue, and black accents in the foreground, with a smaller, matching sneaker on her other foot. Her right hand is raised with bracelets.
The background is a high-key, stylized light blue gradient, with abstract architectural lines and motion streaks of a city, and a huge, translucent, light blue stylized "NIKE" logo overlapping. The top has text: "JUMP HIGHER. REACH FURTHER." in white with a Nike swoosh. The bottom features large, bold text: "puma”JOGGERS" followed by "POWER. PERFORMANCE. STYLE." The bottom contains more text and logos: "JUST DO IT." and two small Nike swooshes. The entire image has a high-energy, motion-blur-effect aesthetic with graphic textures and a clean, commercial design.

items.title: Anime Museum Poster with Kannon Statue
items.titleZh: A polished Japanese museum exhibition poster in a contemporary anime illustration style, vertical layout, warm ivory and gold color palette with pastel confetti accents, designed like a high-end promotional ad for a spring holiday event. The composition features 4 school-age to young adult female characters in the foreground and one monumental Buddhist statue in the background. At center back is a towering gilded Thousand-Armed Kannon statue with a radiant halo, intricate carved details, many arms fanning outward symmetrically, and hands pressed together in prayer at the chest, glowing with sacred golden light. In the foreground on the right is the largest figure, a friendly young woman guide or older student reaching one hand dramatically toward the viewer in forced perspective; she has {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} shoulder-length hair, a blue striped blouse, a cream sweater draped over her shoulders, and a light skirt, with a warm inviting expression. Across the lower middle are 3 younger schoolgirls in matching uniforms: short-sleeve pale blue shirts with navy ribbon ties and dark blue skirts. The left girl points upward excitedly with one arm raised and wears a small shoulder bag; the center girl holds an exhibition booklet upright; the right girl drinks from a clear water bottle while looking toward the scene. Give all 4 girls lively anime-style faces, glossy hair, soft shading, and energetic museum-outing body language. Fill the poster with dense Japanese typography and decorative graphic shapes. Place a large bold main headline on the left reading {argument name="headline text" default="国宝を見に行こう!"}, with oversized gold and black calligraphy-style characters and one red-highlighted character. Above it, add smaller text: "千手観音、祈りの宇宙". Add a red circular callout near the top left that says "はじめての美術館にもおすすめ!" and a white cloud-shaped speech bubble near the top right that says "いっしょに新しい発見をしよう!". Add a gold ribbon banner under the main headline reading "アスキー美術館 GW開催". Include a pale blue circular information box on the left with 5 lines of Japanese copy describing the statue: "国宝 千手観音立像", "千の手が、千年の祈りを", "伝える", "圧巻のスケールを、", "その目で感じてみて。". In the lower left, place a dark rectangular exhibition plaque with gold trim and 5 text lines: "アスキー美術館 GW特別展", the large title "国宝展", then "千手観音、祈りの宇宙", then the date line {argument name="event dates" default="2026.4.26 SAT - 6.15 SUN"}. Along the bottom center, add the museum name in large text: {argument name="museum name" default="アスキー美術館"}, followed by a smaller address line and nearest-station access text in Japanese. Add a red-and-black slogan along the bottom right: "心に残る体験が、きっとここに。". In the lower right, include 3 circular benefit icons with captions: one peach circle with a ticket icon and text "学生はお得! 学生証提示で当日券200円OFF!", one blue circle with a camera icon and text "撮影OK! 一部の作品は写真撮影OK!", and one gold circle with a gift icon and text "来場者プレゼント! オリジナルしおりをプレゼント!". Scatter subtle sparkles, halftone dots, abstract blobs, and confetti shapes around the page. Overall mood: inviting, educational, elegant, and exciting, combining sacred cultural grandeur with cheerful youthful discovery, like a fictional premium museum advertisement generated as a complete poster with integrated typography.

Show a small child, about toddler to preschool age, running joyfully toward the camera from left-center, with one arm raised high holding a tall pole with 2 carp streamers attached: 1 large blue koinobori on top and 1 smaller red koinobori below. The child wears a simple handmade samurai helmet folded from paper, a loose long-sleeve ivory shirt, light beige pants with rolled cuffs, and white sneakers. Keep the face unobtrusive and generic, with the focus on motion, innocence, and seasonal atmosphere. Surround the child with delicate hand-drawn doodle illustrations in thin gray pencil-like lines and faint pastel accents: 2 puffy clouds, 1 flying bird, 1 small origami crane near the text, 4 drifting leaves, 2 curved wind-line clusters, 1 small house, 2 tall trees, 2 purple iris flowers with grass at the bottom left, and sparse grass marks along the ground. On the right side, add elegant Japanese handwritten text reading {argument name="headline text" default="こどもの日"}, beneath it smaller Japanese text {argument name="subtext" default="すこやかな\n成長を願って。"}, and below that the English subtitle {argument name="english subtitle" default="Children's Day"} in a light handwritten script. Use a clean editorial layout with abundant negative space, natural soft lighting, muted cream and beige tones, subtle pastel blue and red accents, gentle shadows, and a calm premium lifestyle-photography look suitable for a seasonal holiday card or social media post.

items.titleZh: A soft, airy promotional hero image for a {argument name="class theme" default="Japanese home cooking class"} on a warm off-white background, styled like a minimalist lifestyle flyer. On the left half, show 2 people: an adult woman and a young girl cooking together at a white kitchen counter, both with calm, natural poses and gentle body language. The woman stands slightly behind and to the left of the child, leaning in supportively while helping guide the girl's hands as she slices a cucumber on a wooden cutting board with a kitchen knife. Their faces are intentionally obscured with soft rectangular blur blocks. The woman has dark brown hair tied in a low ponytail and wears a loose white blouse with a natural linen apron. The girl has dark hair in a high bun and wears a light short-sleeve top with a matching beige linen apron. On the counter, include a clear glass mixing bowl with salad, a folded striped kitchen towel, a wooden bowl of vegetables on the far left, a small wooden tray or plate with colorful vegetables in front, and a small potted green herb plant near the center-right edge of the cooking area. Visible produce should include sliced cucumber on the board and whole vegetables such as tomatoes, leafy greens, mushrooms, lemons or yellow citrus, and green peppers or cucumbers, arranged in a fresh, wholesome way. On the right half, leave generous negative space and place elegant Japanese headline text in a refined serif style: {argument name="headline text" default="お料理教室開講"}. Beneath it, add 2 lines of smaller Japanese body text: {argument name="subtext" default="はじめてさんも、もっと楽しみたい方も。 一緒に『おいしい』を作りましょう。"}. Surround the composition with 7 delicate hand-drawn dark gray doodle elements: 1 small leafy sprig on the far left, 1 hanging line at the upper left with 5 kitchen tools suspended from it (a frying pan, a spatula, a ladle, a peeler or slim utensil, and an oven mitt), 1 cluster of 2 floating leaves in the upper right, 1 small cooking pot icon on the right, 1 whisking bowl icon with tiny hearts near the lower middle-right, and 1 long single-line flourish sweeping across the lower right. items.title: Alishan One-Day Travel Poster
items.titleZh: Create a vintage illustrated travel poster in traditional Chinese for {argument name="destination name" default="阿里山國家風景區"}, designed as a one-day itinerary infographic with a split vertical layout. The left panel is a parchment-textured itinerary card in warm beige with ornate gold Art Nouveau borders and dark brown typography, and the right panel is a dramatic painted fantasy-realism map scene of a mountain journey at sunrise and sunset tones. At the top of the left panel, large headline text reads {argument name="headline text" default="阿里山國家風景區一日遊"}. Beneath it, include a short centered tagline in traditional Chinese: 「一座高山，五個經典景點。難忘的奇幻旅程。」 with a small decorative mountain divider. The left panel must contain exactly 5 numbered itinerary stops stacked vertically, each with a circular black-and-gold number badge, a small vignette illustration, a bold location name, a time in parentheses, and a short Chinese description. The 5 stops are: 1. 「阿里山車站」 at 「(8:00 AM)」 with a wooden mountain railway station illustration and description 「開啟探索神木與森林的旅程。」 2. 「阿里山森林鐵路」 at 「(9:30 AM)」 with a red-and-black steam train illustration and description 「穿越森林，體驗百年林鐵風情。」 3. 「神木區棧道」 at 「(11:30 AM)」 with giant cedar trees and elevated wooden boardwalk illustration and description 「漫步千年巨木下，感受森林靈氣。」 4. 「姊妹潭」 at 「(1:30 PM)」 with a tranquil forest lake and pavilion illustration and description 「欣賞靜謐湖光，聆聽自然樂章。」 5. 「小笠原山展望台」 at 「(4:00 PM)」 with a wooden observation deck above clouds at sunset illustration and description 「觀賞壯闊山景與雲海，欣賞日落。」 The right panel should depict a continuous glowing golden path winding through exactly 5 numbered map markers that match the left panel labels in order, with black-and-gold marker plaques reading: 1 「阿里山車站」, 2 「阿里山森林鐵路」, 3 「神木區棧道」, 4 「姊妹潭」, 5 「小笠原山展望台」. Show stop 1 as a rustic alpine wooden station perched on a cliff among pine forests; stop 2 as a small steam locomotive traveling on a curved mountain railway with smoke drifting upward; stop 3 as towering ancient red cypress trees with a spiral and zigzag wooden walkway around the trunks; stop 4 as an emerald lake surrounded by dense forest with a small pavilion and arched bridge; stop 5 as a lookout deck on a peak above a sea of clouds, facing a glowing sunset. The environment should feature layered mountain ranges, mist-filled valleys, evergreen forests, golden-hour light, luminous cloud seas, and a romantic painterly atmosphere with rich detail. At the bottom right, add a decorative compass rose labeled N, E, S, W, plus a dark green and gold information box with exactly 2 stats in traditional Chinese: 「總距離 ~9公里 / 5.6英里」 and 「預計時間 全天 - 14,500步」. Overall style: premium tourism poster, painterly digital illustration, nostalgic national-park brochure aesthetic, highly detailed, warm sepia and gold accents, elegant composition, readable Chinese text, vertical 2:3 poster.

items.title: Absurd Tabloid Panther Newspaper Front Page
items.titleZh:
A realistic, slightly humorous tabloid newspaper front page photographed from above on a wooden table, designed to look like a printed broadsheet with subtle paper texture, fold marks, and mild lens distortion. The masthead at top left reads “The Daily Metro”, the date line near the top center reads “Friday, April 22, 2005”, and the top-right section marker reads “CITY NEWS | 05”. A red banner near the upper left says “EXCLUSIVE STORY”. The dominant oversized black headline spans multiple lines: “Zoo Panther Caught Living Double Life – As a Charming Bar Hopping Casanova!” Below it, a large subheadline reads: ““Marquise” the Panther Escapes Zoo at Night, Spends Eveningsvlenlars, Becomes Heartthrob Among Lonely Women”. The page layout should mimic a sensational tabloid with 1 huge headline area, 1 large main photo on the upper right, 1 small inset photo under the main text on the left, 3 narrow text columns with dense newspaper copy in the center-left, 1 pull-quote box in the middle, 1 lower-left secondary story block with a panther portrait, 3 small bottom photo thumbnails in a row, and 1 right-side sidebar box titled “What’s Next For Mamquiss?”. Keep most body text tiny and partly nonsensical or pseudo-legible like AI-generated newspaper filler, but preserve the major visible headlines exactly.

The main photo on the upper right shows the back view of a glamorous blonde woman in a silky champagne-colored dress standing at a bar beside a large black panther upright on a stool or standing with forepaws elevated near the counter. The bar background contains many liquor bottles and glassware on shelves, warmly lit. The woman’s face is intentionally obscured by a rectangular blur/block. The panther is sleek, glossy, and realistically rendered. The inset photo under the headline at left shows the black panther near a zoo exit or pathway sign at night. The lower-left portrait shows a close-up of the panther’s face. The 3 bottom thumbnails show nightlife scenes: the panther moving through a bar interior, the panther seated near two women at a small round table, and the panther lounging in dim warm light.

Use an early-2000s tabloid aesthetic, high-contrast black headline typography, off-white newsprint, red accent rules, narrow columns, and slightly messy authentic newspaper composition. The overall tone is deadpan absurdist journalism, realistic enough to glance as a real newspaper, with the page filling most of the frame and photographed in natural indoor light.

Create a dramatic anime-style social media battle poster inspired by X/Twitter, split vertically down the center into two opposing halves with a glowing lightning-like divide and a huge luminous VS at the bottom center. The composition is a tall smartphone-optimized promotional key visual with dense layered UI cards, speech bubbles, tweet screenshots, reaction counters, and explosive energy effects. At the top center, place a large X logo with the title text "BATTLE" and the Japanese subtitle "Xでレスバ中". The left side is a cool purple and black theme, the right side is a hot red and white theme, with sparks, streaks, embers, and motion lines flying across both sides.

Show 2 anime schoolgirl characters facing off. On the left, a calm, composed girl representing logical rebuttal: long dark black-to-purple gradient hair, straight bangs, pale skin, slim build, black sailor-style school uniform with purple neck ribbon, pleated skirt, black knee socks, loafers, holding a smartphone in one hand and touching her glasses or temple with the other. Her face is intentionally obscured by a rectangular blur mosaic over the central face area. Her stance is reserved and still. Surround her with purple glowing tweet cards and speech bubbles. items.title: Dark Fantasy PS5 RPG Cover Art
items.titleZh: A dramatic Japanese fantasy action RPG key art designed like a PlayStation 5 game cover poster. Vertical composition, ultra-detailed, high-contrast, cinematic dark fantasy. In the background, count 2 enormous black-purple dragons: one dominant dragon on the upper right with mouth wide open, glowing orange fire in its throat, jagged obsidian scales, and blazing eyes; one second dragon silhouette on the upper left with wings spread across the sky. Full moon in the center-top sky, purple nebula clouds, embers, ash, magical sparks, and a ruined gothic castle city on the right background. In the foreground, count 3 female elf warriors standing in a heroic triangular formation, all wearing ornate metallic armor with glossy magenta, silver, and violet tones. Center character: blonde elf princess-warrior, short to medium hair, small crown or jeweled tiara, white fur mantle over shoulders, polished silver armor exposing midriff, black gloves, confident battle stance, wielding a gigantic double-bladed ceremonial axe with intricate filigree, turquoise crystal core, and engraved silver-blue blades. Left character: taller elf archer-warrior with long light brown hair, pointed ears, elaborate rose-magenta armor, large curved fantasy sword in her right hand, and a quiver of pink-fletched arrows on her back. Right character: long dark magenta-haired elf swordswoman with floral hair ornaments, violet-magenta armor, black cape, holding a slender sword angled downward. The image should feel like premium box art for an original game titled {argument name="game title" default="ECLIPSE SAGA"}. Include visible game-package typography and branding elements: top left white PS5 logo; top right small bracketed studio tag [O-prompt laboratory]; large vertical Japanese slogan on the right side; count 2 lines of Japanese promotional copy on the upper left; the main title in huge glowing gold serif letters across the bottom center reading {argument name="game title" default="ECLIPSE SAGA"}; a smaller Japanese subtitle beneath it; bottom left CERO C rating badge; bottom center count 3 short Japanese feature blurbs separated by diamond icons; bottom right OPL logo. Use a lavish painted-anime-meets-hyperreal style, dense detail, polished reflections, fiery rim light, purple and orange color contrast, and the overall feel of a mature-rated epic console fantasy adventure cover.

items.title: Fantasy RPG Game Cover with Three Knight Women
items.titleZh: A dramatic Japanese fantasy action RPG PlayStation 5 game cover poster in a dark ornate high-fantasy style, vertically composed like premium key art. Show three armored warrior women standing heroically in the foreground against a glowing night battlefield and a towering gothic fantasy castle city in the distance, with fireworks, embers, magical light trails, and a star-filled purple-blue sky. The central figure is a blonde elf-like knight with pointed ears, a fur-trimmed collar, silver and gold armor, and a powerful stance, holding an enormous double-headed ceremonial battle axe angled across the lower half of the image; the axe is highly detailed with filigree silver metalwork, turquoise-blue crystal inlays, and an intricate engraved circular blade. On the left stands a second female knight with long dark crimson hair, metallic breastplate armor in steel and burgundy tones, and a sword held downward; behind her looms 1 giant black raven or crow with one glowing blue eye. On the right stands a third female knight with long light brown hair covering her eyes, pointed ears, and glossy magenta-pink armor with revealing fantasy plate design; a quiver of arrows is visible behind her shoulder. Include 2 red flying bird-like creatures or phoenixes in the upper right sky. The mood is epic, intense, and slightly gothic, with dense sparks, glowing particles, rim lighting, and lavish metallic reflections. Add an ornate thin gold border framing the entire cover. At the top left, place a small circular emblem and the text "O-prompt Laboratory". Along the right side, add vertical Japanese tagline text: "絆と力に、運命を斬り拓け". At the bottom center, place the game title in large embossed gold serif letters: "{argument name="game title" default="ELYSION"}", with a subtitle beneath in smaller serif capitals: "{argument name="subtitle" default="REBIRTH"}". Below that, add the Japanese subtitle text "エリシオン・リバース". At the bottom left, include a realistic Japanese age rating badge reading "CERO C" with small text "15才以上対象". Along the bottom, add the Japanese tagline "美しき騎士たちの、終わりなき戦いが今、始まる。" and beneath it the English line "THE ETERNAL BATTLE OF THE KNIGHTS BEGINS NOW.". Make it look like polished AAA console box art for a nonexistent fantasy game, ultra-detailed, cinematic, richly textured, high contrast, with the composition dominated by the three women and the oversized axe.

items.title: Traditional Japanese Buddhist Statue
items.titleZh: A {argument name="type of Buddhist statue" default="standing statue of Senju Kannon Bodhisattva"} reminiscent of ancient Japanese Buddhist sculpture. It features a serene and majestic atmosphere similar to the masterpieces housed in the {argument name="collection" default="Tokyo National Museum"}. A full-body frontal view with a slender and elegant physique, a soft and compassionate expression, half-closed eyes, and a gentle smile. It includes an exquisite crown, flowing celestial robes, and delicate jewelry. A large number of arms are arranged in an orderly radial pattern behind the back to strongly emphasize the symbolism of the Thousand-Armed Kannon. The hands may be based on 42 arms in accordance with actual sculptural traditions. It stands on a lotus pedestal with a halo behind. The material is primarily {argument name="material" default="wood carving"}, depicting historical textures such as lacquer, peeling gold leaf, weathered colors from aging, traces of original color, cracks, wear, and a sense of temple heritage. The overall design evokes Japanese Buddhist sculptures of the Heian to Kamakura periods, characterized by dignity, nobility, and religious solemnity. Like a professional photograph of a museum collection, the background is dark and subdued, highlighting the three-dimensionality and texture of the statue. Museum-grade, cultural asset-grade, ultra-high definition.
items.prompt: 日本の古仏彫刻を思わせる、{argument name="仏像の種類" default="千手観音菩薩立像"}。{argument name="所蔵元" default="東京国立博物館"}に所蔵されている名品仏像のような、静謐で荘厳な雰囲気。正面向きの全身像、細身で端正な体躯、やわらかく慈悲深い表情、半眼、穏やかな微笑。頭上に精緻な宝冠、流麗な天衣、繊細な装身具。背後には放射状に広がる多数の腕を整然と配置し、千手観音の象徴性を強く示す。手は実際の仏像表現に即して42臂を基調としてもよい。台座は蓮華座、背後に光背。材質は{argument name="材質" default="木彫"}を基調に、漆箔、金箔の剥落、経年による古色、わずかな彩色の残存、ひび、摩耗、寺院伝来の歴史ある質感を表現。全体は平安〜鎌倉期の日本仏像彫刻を思わせる、端正で高貴、宗教性あふれる、宗教的荘厳さに満ちた造形。美術館で撮影された収蔵品写真のように、背景は暗めで落ち着き、像の立体感と質感が際立つ。博物館級、文化財級、超高精細。

items.title: Anime McDonald's Recommendation Poster
items.titleZh: A vibrant Japanese fast-food promotional anime poster in a vertical layout, themed around McDonald's recommendations. The background is a bold red and white graphic design with golden sparkles, sweeping shapes, and energetic ad-style composition. In the upper left corner, show the McDonald's golden arches logo inside a red square. On the left half, feature a stylish anime girl with fox or wolf ears and a fluffy tail, shown from mid-thigh up, wearing a modern dark navy and black streetwear outfit with blue accents: cropped top exposing the midriff, layered jacket, belt, straps, and small decorative pins. Her hair is {argument name="hair color" default="dark purple"}, medium-length and tousled. Her face is intentionally obscured by a soft blurred rectangular censor block. She holds a large sesame-seed burger in her left hand and gestures invitingly with her right hand toward the food items. Across the top right, include large Japanese headline text reading 彩葉のおすすめ！マクドナルド, with a smaller black banner beneath it reading 食べたくなる定番メニューをチェック！. Arrange 4 numbered menu callouts in rounded white speech-bubble labels with red and yellow accents: item 1 is ビッグマック next to a Big Mac image near the center-right; item 2 is マックフライポテト next to a tall red fries carton on the right; item 3 is チキンマックナゲット next to an open nugget box containing exactly 6 chicken nuggets and a cup of red dipping sauce near the lower center-right; item 4 is てりやきマックバーガー next to a glossy teriyaki burger near the lower left-center. Also place a white McDonald's drink cup with ice and dark soda in the bottom left. On the right side, include 2 small informational badges stacked vertically: one badge with a sun and moon icon and Japanese text 朝は朝マック、夜は夜マックも楽しめる！, and one badge with a smartphone icon and Japanese text アプリでモバイルオーダーも便利！. At the very bottom, add a large bold Japanese slogan in white and yellow on a red banner: 今日はマックに行きたくなる！. Add tiny disclaimer text along the lower edge. The illustration style is polished, colorful anime key visual art mixed with commercial food photography rendering for the burgers, fries, nuggets, and drink; highly appetizing, glossy lighting, clean outlines, dynamic ad composition, and a cheerful promotional mood.

items.title: Anime KFC Princess Promo Poster
items.titleZh: A vibrant Japanese fast-food promotional poster in glossy anime advertising style, themed around KFC and a magical princess mascot. The composition is vertical and packed but still a single unified ad scene. At center-right, a cheerful young anime woman inspired by Princess Kaguya poses energetically toward the viewer with one hand reaching forward and the other arm lifted. She has long flowing golden-blonde hair, large sparkling amber-red eyes, a bright open smile, and ornate hair accessories including red floral ornaments, dangling beads, green ribbons, and a small gold crescent-moon crown. She wears a festive kimono-inspired outfit in coral red, soft pink, cream, and olive green with layered sleeves, floral patterns, decorative cords, bows, tassels, and a wide obi with a flower knot. Her hair and sleeves sweep dramatically as if caught in a lively breeze. In the lower left foreground, show 1 large KFC bucket overflowing with 4 pieces of crispy fried chicken, rendered extra crunchy, golden, juicy, and appetizing. Along the bottom foreground, include 3 side items: 1 chicken burger with sesame bun and lettuce, 1 small carton of fries, and 1 biscuit or pie-like pastry topped with glossy syrup. Use the KFC logo in the top right and on the bucket and fries carton, with the Colonel face partially censored by a rectangular blur on the bucket. Surround the scene with celebratory red-and-gold graphics, sparkles, brushstroke flourishes, and festive Japanese New Year-like motifs. Add large bold Japanese headline text at the upper left reading ケンタッキーの魅力 in thick red characters with white and gold outline. Add 2 white brushstroke callout bubbles on the left with red text: サクッと香ばしい！ and ジューシーで大満足！. Add a red flower-shaped badge on the right reading 今日のごほうびに. Add a red bottom banner with white text listing オリジナルチキン / バーガー / ビスケット. Extremely polished commercial illustration, high saturation, warm lighting, clean line art, glossy food rendering, energetic composition, premium poster finish.

items.title: Anime MOS Burger Promo Poster
items.titleZh:
A polished Japanese fast-food promotional poster in a bright anime-advertisement style, combining a fantasy princess character with clean product photography and cheerful branding. The composition is landscape and split visually: on the left, a full-body anime girl inspired by a moon-princess or bamboo-princess aesthetic stands in a welcoming pose with one hand extended toward the viewer and the other hand near her face. She has very long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white with pastel pink and lavender gradients"} hair, large expressive eyes, and an elegant floral-and-ribbon hair ornament in dark blue, gold, pink, and turquoise. Her outfit is a luxurious modernized kimono dress in white, teal, navy, and pink with translucent sleeves, floral patterns, layered obi bows, tassels, and gold ornaments, with a magical sparkling atmosphere around her. Behind her is a dreamy teal-and-cream background with soft circles, starry sparkles, faint floral motifs, sweeping decorative lines, and a subtle silhouette of a Japanese pagoda.

On the right is a neat food-ad layout for {argument name="brand name" default="MOS BURGER"}, with the red MOS BURGER logo at the top left corner and again at the bottom right. At the top center-right, place a green ribbon banner with the Japanese text "モスバーガー特集". Below it, add a large elegant handwritten-style Japanese headline: "行きたくなる、できたてのおいしさ。" with the middle phrase "できたて" emphasized in vivid pink-red while the rest is black. Under that, add a smaller subheadline in Japanese: "ヤチヨ風の幻想感 × モスのごほうびバーガー". 

Feature exactly 4 food items arranged horizontally across the middle-right, each rendered as appetizing semi-photorealistic product shots with soft shadows and crisp detail. Item 1: a classic burger with bun, thick meat patty, sauce, mayonnaise, and a large tomato slice, with a red circular badge reading "定番人気" and the label "モスバーガー" plus small Japanese descriptive text beneath. Item 2: a teriyaki burger with lettuce and glossy sauce, with a green circular badge reading "和風人気" and the label "テリヤキバーガー" plus small Japanese descriptive text beneath. Item 3: a white paper carton of onion rings with a yellow circular badge reading "サイドも最高" and the label "オニポテ" plus small Japanese descriptive text beneath. Item 4: a pink milkshake in a clear cup with straw, with a blue circular badge reading "ひんやり甘い" and the label "モスシェイク" plus small Japanese descriptive text beneath. 

Below the products, add a rounded rectangular recommendation box with a teal border and a teal ribbon title reading "おすすめポイント". Inside, include exactly 4 bullet points in Japanese with pink flower-like bullets, describing made-to-order freshness, the appeal of the classic meat sauce and tomato burger, the Japanese-style popularity of teriyaki burger, and that onion rings and shake are also must-try items. To the right inside the same lower area, include a smaller rounded box with line-art icons of cutlery, a drink, and a burger, plus Japanese copy that reads "モスのこだわり" and "おいしさは、まごころから。" followed by smaller explanatory Japanese text.

Across the bottom, place a large curved banner with a teal gradient and white center glow containing the Japanese slogan "今日はモスに寄り道しよう。" with "モス" highlighted in bold red. Near the lower right, add a small orange-red circular callout with Japanese text similar to "あなたのお気に入りがきっと見つかる!". Use a crisp commercial poster layout, vivid teal, aqua, white, pink, and gold accents, glossy food rendering, decorative sparkles, and a premium collaboration feel between anime fantasy illustration and modern restaurant advertising.

items.title: Chinese Schoolchildren at Corner Shop
items.titleZh: A candid, photorealistic street documentary photo of three primary school children buying snacks at a small old-fashioned neighborhood convenience shop in China, shot in soft natural daylight. The scene is framed straight-on at storefront level, with a slightly compressed everyday snapshot feel, realistic textures, and subtle depth. On the left, one schoolgirl stands in profile wearing a light pink zip-up jacket, dark jeans, and a red scarf, her black hair tied in a ponytail with a white headband, looking down at coins or a small item in her hands. In the center, one schoolboy stands with his back to the camera in a bright blue school tracksuit and a navy-and-red backpack featuring a Mickey Mouse graphic, leaning slightly toward the counter. On the right, one younger schoolgirl with two low pigtails tied with pale pink hair ties leans against a large chest freezer, wearing a white long-sleeve top and blue athletic pants, with a pink backpack resting beside her. Behind the counter, inside the dim shop interior, one shopkeeper in a pink top with a cartoon character print stands partially obscured in shadow. The counter is cluttered with packaged snacks, clear plastic bags of candy, colorful biscuit boxes, jars, and small goods; the shelves behind are densely packed with drinks and snacks. A bunch of multicolored balloons hangs near the upper center of the shop entrance. The chest freezer in the foreground is white with a green lid trim and green Chinese branding on the side. The storefront is worn and modest, with peeling beige walls, a posted calendar or notice sheet on the left wall, metal-framed windows, and an open service window. Include authentic Chinese neighborhood shop details, natural messiness, believable lighting, muted urban colors, and an unposed slice-of-life atmosphere. Faces should be softly obscured or turned away, emphasizing realism and privacy rather than portrait detail.

The shirt is shown from the upper torso down to part of the hem, slightly angled, with soft natural folds and high-quality cotton texture. Hanging from the neckline is 1 rectangular recycled-paper seed tag tied with rustic brown twine; the tag reads "Tulsi" and "Plantable Seed Tag" with a tiny sprouting seed detail near the bottom. At the lower right, add 3 lines of small uppercase sans-serif text: "FSC® CERTIFIED PACKAGING.", "ZERO SYNTHETIC FIBRE", and "BACKED BY ZERODHA.". Keep the design minimal, premium, and photorealistic, with the shirt occupying the left half and the typography balanced on the right.

Add a poetic text block on the left in Chinese: “山水缙云，仙都奇境 百味乡野，烟火人间 跟着美食，遇见缙云 一城山水，一口乡愁”. In the center is the main county town labeled “缙云县城”, surrounded by illustrated routes connecting scenic destinations and local dishes. Include exactly 12 numbered food stops, each with a realistic painted bowl or plate of food placed on the map near its location, with orange circular numbers and Chinese labels plus a short one-line description. The 12 stops are: 1 “河阳土爽面” with description “山野本味，宾客烟火”; 2 “笕川笋干菜” with description “时令山珍，晒干留香”; 3 “缙云烧饼” with description “炭炉焦香，卷云招牌”; 4 “敲肉羹” with description “鲜香软糯，地道乡味”; 5 “岩下炖汤” with description “石材慢炖，暖身养胃”; 6 “溪鱼鲜” with description “山水河鲜，鲜掉眉毛”; 7 “壶镇扁食/落菜” with description “古法胶味，越吃越香”; 8 “葛根豆腐” with description “山野清润，解腻爽口”; 9 “山粉饺” with description “皮薄馅足，山野风味”; 10 “苦槠豆腐” with description “山林珍味，自然本鲜”; 11 “农家焐年糕” with description “糯香浓郁，儿时味道”; 12 “老街米糕” with description “清甜米香，古法手工”. Paint recognizable scenic clusters with white-walled black-roofed traditional houses, steep karst peaks, bridges, and terraced terrain. Add a small legend box at the lower right with exactly 5 items labeled “山脉”, “河流”, “主要道路”, “乡镇”, and “景点地标”, plus a sixth food icon label “美食推荐”. Include a decorative compass rose nearby. items.title: 1998 Rural School Gate Shop Photo
items.titleZh: A realistic documentary-style color photo set in {argument name="year" default="1998"}, showing the entrance of a rural Chinese primary school and the small roadside shop beside it. The scene is viewed at street level on a dusty, uneven dirt road in a North China village, with old brick houses, weathered walls, utility poles, bicycles, and tall autumn trees in the background. The school gate is made of aged brick and concrete, with a sign above it reading “前进小学”, and vertical characters on the gate pillars also reading “前进小学”. On the long wall next to the gate, there is a faded painted slogan in red characters: “好好学习 天天向上”. To the right of the gate is a humble brick-and-tile storefront with a hand-painted signboard reading “大众副食店” and a smaller line below reading “文具 日杂 零售”. In front of the shop is a simple metal counter where a female shopkeeper is selling snacks to schoolchildren. items.title: Professional Tool Launch Poster
items.titleZh: 1. Design a modern tech-style poster for an "AI Agent tool launch," vertical 4:5 aspect ratio, with a clear and eye-catching main title and a subtitle explaining product value. Use a black, white, and gray color palette with fluorescent green accents. Include abstract networks, code windows, and agent nodes. The overall look should resemble a high-end SaaS launch poster, and text must be accurate and readable. 2. Generate a cover image suitable for an X/Twitter long-form post titled "2026 AI Tool Trends," horizontal 16:9 aspect ratio, with a clean and sophisticated style. Include the title and 3 keywords: Agent / Workflow / Automation. The background should be a combination of desktop workflows, browsers, terminals, and data panels, with a layout like a tech media header. 3. Generate an advertisement for a Web3 wallet security tool. The center of the image shows a phone displaying the wallet interface, surrounded by on-chain addresses, risk alerts, shield icons, and transaction path visualizations. The style should be professional and trustworthy, with the Chinese title: "Making every on-chain operation safer." 4. Create a Chinese infographic titled "The 5 Layers of AI Agent Capabilities," including: understanding tasks, calling tools, reading data, executing operations, and reviewing/optimizing. Show this in a clear hierarchical structure, each layer with a small icon, white background, and tech-blue accents. 5. Generate a one-page 4-panel comic strip about a creator going from manually searching for info, writing copy, and making images to completing the workflow automatically with an AI Agent. The style should be lighthearted and humorous, with consistent characters and short, clear Chinese dialogue. The last panel should highlight "double the efficiency." 6. Generate a roadmap visual for an AI x Crypto project, including three phases: Q2, Q3, and Q4: MVP, Agent Marketplace, and Onchain Automation. The style should look like a product page in a funding deck—clean, credible, futuristic, and with clearly readable text.
items.prompt: 1. 为「AI Agent 工具发布」设计一张现代科技感海报，竖版 4:5，主标题清晰醒目，副标题解释产品价值，使用黑白灰+荧光绿点缀，包含抽象网络、代码窗口、智能体节点，整体像高端 SaaS 发布海报，文字必须准确可读。 2. 生成一张适合 X/Twitter 长文的封面图，主题是「2026 AI 工具趋势」，横版 16:9，风格干净高级，包含标题、3个关键词：Agent / Workflow / Automation，背景是桌面工作流、浏览器、终端、数据面板的组合，排版像科技媒体头图。 3. 为一款 Web3 钱包安全工具生成广告图，画面中心是一部手机展示钱包界面，周围有链上地址、风险预警、盾牌图标、交易路径可视化，风格专业可信，中文标题：让每一笔链上操作更安全。 4. 制作一张中文信息图，主题是「AI Agent 的 5 层能力」，包含：理解任务、调用工具、读取数据、执行操作、复盘优化。用清晰层级结构展示，每一层配一个小图标，白底，科技蓝点缀。 5. 生成一页 4 格漫画，讲一个创作者从手动找资料、写文案、做图，到用 AI Agent 自动完成工作流的过程。风格轻松幽默，人物一致，中文对白简短清晰，最后一格突出“效率翻倍”。 6. 为一个 AI x Crypto 项目生成路线图视觉图，包含 Q2、Q3、Q4 三个阶段：MVP、Agent Marketplace、Onchain Automation。风格像融资 Deck 里的产品页，干净、可信、有未来感，文字清晰可读。

items.title: Pastel Blue Crocs Fashion Ad
items.titleZh: A high-end studio advertising poster for {argument name="brand name" default="crocs"}, in a monochrome pastel blue and white color palette, with a glossy reflective floor and a soft sky-blue backdrop. The background is dominated by the word {argument name="headline text" default="CROCS"} in gigantic bold white condensed sans-serif letters spanning nearly the full height of the image. In the top-right corner, add small white text reading "Designed with ChatGPT". Feature 3 adult women with shoulder-length wavy light brown to dark blonde hair, all wearing loose oversized white long-sleeve tops and flowing white wide-leg pants, styled as minimalist fashion models with relaxed neutral expressions. Their faces are intentionally obscured or blurred. One model reclines against an enormous upright white clog shoe on the left side, one model sits casually on top of a giant white clog on the upper right, and one model lounges on the floor at the lower right, leaning back on one arm while seated partly on a glossy blue sphere. Include 2 oversized white clog shoes as hero props: one standing vertically on the left showing the sole and side profile, and one angled on blue crystalline blocks at center-right showing the upper and toe box. Both clogs are classic foam slip-on style with perforation holes, chunky tread, heel straps, and circular logo rivets. The center-right clog is decorated with exactly 8 visible charms pinned to the upper: a blue-green iridescent round charm, a white daisy with yellow center, a black-and-white round emblem near the strap, a small "CROCS" word charm, a dark flower, a peace-hand sign, an orange smiley face, a white cloud, and an orange flower. Scatter exactly 7 glossy floating or grounded blue spheres of varying sizes around the set: one large sphere behind the left model, one medium sphere floating near center, one medium sphere at bottom left foreground, one medium sphere used as a seat under the lower-right model, one small sphere near the upper left, and 2 additional blue spheres integrated into the composition. Add translucent sculptural gel-like forms at the far left and far right edges, plus angular blue crystal-like rocks beneath the right shoe. At the bottom center, place white promotional copy in a clean sans-serif font: {argument name="tagline line 1" default="Made for comfort, worn for confidence."} on the first line and {argument name="tagline line 2" default="Because life feels better when your feet stop complaining."} on the second line. Beneath that, show 4 minimalist feature icons with labels in white: "ICONIC COMFORT", "LIGHTWEIGHT", "EASY TO CLEAN", and "UNIQUELY YOU". Place the {argument name="logo text" default="crocs"} logo in bold lowercase white at the bottom center with a small trademark symbol. The overall style should feel like a premium surreal fashion campaign, clean editorial lighting, soft shadows, glossy textures, airy composition, and modern lifestyle product advertising.

items.titleZh: A dramatic futuristic Chinese smartphone launch poster for {argument name="brand name" default="HONOR"} promoting the gaming phone {argument name="product name" default="WIN X"}, in a tall premium advertisement layout with a dark blue and black sci-fi palette, ultra-detailed 3D product rendering, glossy metallic surfaces, intense blue energy glow, cinematic lighting, and a high-end commercial look. The background shows a vast frozen mountain range and icy lake at night under a stormy cosmic sky, with a gigantic luminous X-shaped light formation centered behind the phone, creating a heroic focal point. At the top left is the brand wordmark “HONOR”, and at the top right is the Chinese tagline “荣耀电竞神机”. Across the upper center is a huge bold metallic Chinese headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="以我知 探未知"}, rendered in oversized beveled silver typography with slight ice-texture highlights. Beneath it is a smaller line of Chinese text “荣耀 WIN X 新品发布”. In the center foreground, show 2 phones standing on a circular futuristic platform surrounded by mist and reflected blue light: the left phone shows the exterior back design in a three-quarter front-left angle, with a transparent industrial cyber-mechanical shell, angular panel lines, visible screws, a large black polygonal camera module near the top, “GT” marking on the upper right edge, a diagonal red accent slash, vertical “HONOR” branding near the lower left, and a large circular turbine cooling fan in the lower middle glowing bright electric blue with visible blades and a center cap labeled HONOR; the right phone stands slightly behind and to the right, showing the internal structure through an opened transparent back, with another bright blue circular cooling core near the upper center emitting energy beams to the right, and a massive vertical battery module labeled in huge text “15000mAh”. On the left side, include 3 stacked glowing rectangular feature panels with neon blue borders: panel 1 shows a small lake landscape image and Chinese text headed “15000mAh 青海湖电池” with smaller lines “超大容量 超长续航” and “-20℃ 极寒环境依旧耐用”; panel 2 shows a fan image and Chinese text headed “超强制冷风扇” with smaller lines “20000rpm 高速风扇” and “瞬时降温 战力全开”; panel 3 shows a chip image and Chinese text headed “最新骁龙 8Elite Gen6 处理器” with smaller lines “台积电 2nm 制程工艺” and “超强性能 巅峰能效”, plus a red-gold Snapdragon chip illustration labeled “Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6”. At the bottom center, place the product name in very large text “荣耀 WIN X”, with “WIN X” in bright blue gradient and the rest in metallic white, and beneath it the smaller slogan “为战而生 进化不止”. Along the very bottom edge, add a thin row of small Chinese specs text: “15000mAh 青海湖电池 | 超强制冷风扇 | 骁龙 8Elite Gen6 | 165Hz 荣耀绿洲护眼电竞屏”, plus tiny disclaimer text at the lower right. Make the composition symmetrical, aggressive, premium, and epic, like a flagship gaming phone reveal poster from a major tech company.

items.title: Klimt-Style Character Art
items.titleZh:
A vertical work (9:16) in the style of Gustav Klimt's Vienna Secession.

In the center, {argument name="character" default="Mona"} ({argument name="outfit" default="gold magical girl costume"}, brown short bob, banana-shaped tiara) is closing her eyes in a self-contained pose as if embracing.

Elements unique to Klimt:
- Replace all decorative patterns on clothing and background with gold geometric patterns using banana shapes as motifs
- Glowing gold decorations with a texture like real gold leaf
- Only the face and hands are realistic, everything else is a flat decorative pattern
- The background is a mosaic of black and gold swirls and banana shapes
- Dense collection of vortices, spirals, rectangles, and floral geometry
- Painterly texture, the feel of an oil canvas

In the lower right, a plaque-style text reading "{argument name="plaque text" default="MONA BANANA, 2026, Oil and Gold Leaf on Canvas"}."
A dignified piece indistinguishable from a real Klimt work.
items.prompt:
グスタフ・クリムト（Gustav Klimt）のウィーン分離派スタイルの縦型作品（9:16）。

中央に{argument name="キャラクター" default="萌奈"}（{argument name="衣装" default="ゴールド魔法少女衣装"}、茶色ショートボブ、バナナ型ティアラ）が抱擁するような自己完結したポーズで目を閉じている。

クリムト特有の要素：
- 衣装と背景の装飾パターンをすべてバナナの形をモチーフにした金の幾何学紋様で置き換える
- 本物の金箔を貼ったような輝く質感のゴールド装飾
- 顔と手だけが写実的で、それ以外はすべて平面的な装飾パターン
- 背景は黒×金の渦巻きとバナナ形のモザイク
- 渦・螺旋・矩形・花の幾何学が密集
- 絵画的なテクスチャ、油彩キャンバスの質感

右下に"{argument name="銘板テキスト" default="MONA BANANA, 2026, Oil and Gold Leaf on Canvas"}"の銘板風テキスト。
本物のクリムト作品と見紛う格調。

items.titleZh: A stunning anime theatrical movie poster in portrait format. Studio Ghibli meets Makoto Shinkai visual language. A teenage girl in a tattered white shrine maiden robe stands on the wing of a crumbling giant stone deity — an ancient colossus covered in moss and glowing golden kanji script, slowly falling through a sea of clouds. Her long black hair streams upward against gravity. She reaches one hand toward the sky where a vast celestial rift tears open the heavens — beyond it, an inverted ocean floats above the clouds, ancient wooden cities hanging upside down from its surface, lanterns drifting like stars. The sky transitions from deep twilight blue at the bottom to a luminous peach and rose gold at the top. Volumetric god rays pierce through cloud layers. Cherry blossom petals and torn paper talismans spiral everywhere. Her expression is calm determination. Art style: hand-drawn 2D animation, ultra-detailed background painting, expressive linework, rich cel shading. Palette: deep indigo, peach, rose gold, warm amber, soft white. Title in large elegant {argument name="language" default="Japanese kanji"} at the bottom with English subtitle beneath in a clean modern font. Tagline in small white italic text above the title. Mood: mythological, spiritual, bittersweet wonder. Theatrical release quality, Toho Films.

items.title: Hindi Poem Poster with Parashurama
items.titleZh: A vertically oriented literary poster in a muted sepia, ash, and parchment palette with dramatic gold kintsugi-style cracks running diagonally across the entire composition. The background is a soft textured paper and watercolor wash with smoky clouds, worn stains, and faint marbling. In the upper left, place a large faded monochrome portrait bust of an older Indian man in traditional formal attire, partially emerging from the mist like a historical figure or poet, softly blended into the background. In the upper right, set a small Hindi title line {argument name="headline text" default="परशुराम की प्रतीक्षा"} with a smaller author credit below it, elegant and understated. Beneath that, place one large centered Hindi quote in refined serif-style Devanagari, framed by oversized quotation marks, using the exact text {argument name="main quote" default="जब नाश मनुज पर छाता है, पहले विवेक मर जाता है।"}. In the lower half, create a heroic mythic Indian warrior standing on jagged black rocks, facing slightly left, with a powerful windswept stance. He has a bare muscular torso, long wild dark hair blown upward, and a tattered deep red drape wrapped across his body and trailing dramatically to the right in torn ribbons. He holds 1 large battle axe in his left hand, the blade angled downward, suggesting Parashurama. Surround him with dust, smoke, tiny debris, and painterly splashes. Add 2 vertical blocks of smaller Hindi poem text, one on the lower left and one on the lower right of the warrior, balanced like a printed poetry poster. Keep the poem text dense and readable but secondary to the central quote and figure. Use painterly digital illustration with fine art poster aesthetics, soft atmospheric lighting, high contrast around the warrior, and subtle glowing gold fissures crossing through the portrait, text area, rocks, and fabric. The overall mood is solemn, prophetic, patriotic, and intense, like a shareable inspirational poem poster about moral collapse and righteous awakening in India.

items.title: Japanese Space Conference Poster
items.titleZh: A polished Japanese event poster in a dramatic, aspirational sci-fi tourism style for {argument name="event year" default="2026"}, vertical layout, rich deep-blue space background blending into a bright daytime cityscape. At the top, outer space with a detailed Earth seen from orbit at upper left, a radiant sun flare at the planet’s edge, dense stars and faint nebulae across the sky. Large bold central Japanese headline text in white with subtle gold accents and a strong drop shadow: 「宇宙科学技術 連合講演会 {argument name="event year" default="2026"}」, with a smaller slogan above reading 「宇宙の未来を、ともに拓く。」. Surrounding the title, exactly 4 space elements: 1 lunar lander descending at left, 1 small satellite with blue solar panels near center-left, 1 larger satellite at upper right, and 1 white rocket launching vertically on the right with bright exhaust and billowing smoke. Add elegant golden orbital swoosh lines circling around the title and spacecraft. Below the title, place a gold badge reading 「宇科連」 and several centered lines of smaller Japanese descriptive text about Japan’s largest academic event for space science and technology, involving space science, JAXA space policy, space development startups, and comprehensive discussions on Japan’s space development strategy. The lower half transitions to a realistic panoramic view of Utsunomiya, Japan, with mountains in the distance and Mount Fuji-like snowy peak visible on the horizon, modern mid-rise city buildings, and a wide tram corridor. Feature a sleek modern yellow-and-black light rail tram prominently in the lower right foreground, angled toward the viewer, glossy reflective windows, destination sign reading 「宇都宮駅東口」, with overhead lines absent for a clean futuristic feel. Near the right midground behind the tram, include a large white satellite dish antenna facility. At the lower left, show a plated serving of exactly 6 golden-brown gyoza dumplings on a white dish with a small soy sauce dipping bowl in front; add a curved red Japanese label on the plate rim reading 「宇都宮餃子」. Near the gyoza and tram, include a circular dark-blue callout with gold trim describing the host city and specialties, with Japanese text indicating 「開催地 宇都宮市」 and noting famous local items: gyoza and the Utsunomiya light rail. Along the bottom, create a structured navy information band with gold and white text. Include exactly 5 major information blocks: 1) date block on the left with Japanese text 「会期 2026年 11月10日(火)〜11月13日(金)」 in large high-contrast type, 2) organizer/sponsor block listing 「主催 JSASS 一般社団法人 日本航空宇宙学会」 and co-host logos/text for JAXA and NICT plus a smaller line for additional participating academic societies and organizations, 3) venue block with Japanese text 「会場 ライトキューブ宇都宮 栃木県宇都宮市宮みらい1-20」 plus a small rectangular inset photo of a modern glass building, 4) a row of exactly 5 icon-labeled topic categories reading 「宇宙科学」「宇宙探査・観測」「宇宙開発ミッション（JAXA等）」「宇宙政策・制度」「宇宙ビジネス・スタートアップ」 with simple white line icons above each label, and 5) a website/QR block at the bottom right with a search-bar style URL area showing a JSASS conference URL, a visible QR code, and a yellow circular sticker saying 「今後の情報をお届け！」. Use clean commercial-poster composition, glossy photorealistic montage, crisp typography, realistic lighting, strong contrast, gold highlight accents, and a premium official event-poster finish.

items.title: Anime PR Representative at Industrial Expo
items.titleZh: A polished anime-style corporate booth illustration with cel shading and controlled highlights, showing a young adult female PR representative standing three-quarters view in a futuristic industrial exhibition space lit with cool purple and blue accent lighting. Her face is obscured by a centered rectangular blur block. She has very long straight dark hair with subtle purple undertones, flowing past her waist, and wears geometric dangling earrings. Her outfit is a sleek black business suit with white piping along the lapels, a dark inner shirt, a fitted pencil skirt, a belt, and a visible lanyard with ID card. On her left arm she wears a white armband printed with the company logo and the words OHNO HEAVY INDUSTRIES. In one arm she holds a black presentation folder with the same logo and company name, and with her other hand she gestures open-palmed toward the booth displays as if introducing the company. The booth branding is prominent: a large illuminated wall sign in the upper left with the logo, the Japanese company name "大野重工業株式会社", the English name "OHNO HEAVY INDUSTRIES", and the slogan "BUILDING THE FUTURE. SUPPORTING THE WORLD." Below it is a large poster panel showing an industrial refinery skyline at dusk with Japanese copy reading "技術で支え、未来を創る。" and smaller text beneath. In the lower left foreground, place a standing nameplate sign with the same logo and company name, plus the department line "広報部 | PR DIVISION" and the representative name "雲居 モヤ" with the romanization "KUMOI MOYA". Also show her hanging ID badge with the logo and small text suggesting PR staff credentials. The exhibition floor includes 3 visible industrial display elements: a white robotic construction machine model on a pedestal at left, a smaller mechanical display in the mid-background, and a large white humanoid or armored industrial mech figure on the right background. Use a high-end convention or trade-show setting with glossy reflective surfaces, glass panels, sharp perspective lines, and branded panels throughout. Composition should be vertical, waist-up to near full-body framing, with the character dominating the right-center and the company signage clearly readable on the left. Emphasize refined anime character design, professional corporate ambassador energy, futuristic heavy-industry branding, purple ambient glow, and clean cel-shaded rendering rather than overly sparkly effects.

items.title: Baby Emoticon Sticker Grid Generator
items.titleZh: Create a KakaoTalk emoticon-style image using a cute {argument name="subject" default="newborn baby's"} face. Clean background. A total of {argument name="expression count" default="12-16"} different expressions: laughing, crying, sleepy, surprised, blank, eating, frowning, lovely, etc. Add cute Korean text for each expression, for example: Hello!, Huh?, Hehe!, I'm sleepy~, Hing TT, Wow!, I like it!, Che!, Krang!, Yum yum~, Blank~, Sparkle! Style: White border like a sticker, soft colors, includes mini emojis (hearts, water drops, stars, etc.), arranged in a grid on a single sheet, photorealistic base + cute and warm feeling. Please create it based on the attached baby photo, keeping the facial features intact. Maintain the eye, nose, and mouth positions and face shape as much as possible while only changing the expressions.

In the left foreground, a worn wooden bed with a dark headboard is covered by a faded patchwork quilt, with exactly 2 stacked floral pillows near the head of the bed. The walls are stained, cracked, and aged plaster in warm ochre tones, giving the room a lived-in, slightly neglected feeling. On the upper left wall hangs 1 framed vintage street-scene print, and near the center wall hangs 1 dark shoulder bag from a hook. Beside the bed is a small wooden nightstand lit by 1 warm glowing table lamp with a round shade, casting soft amber light and deep shadows across the room. On the windowsill are exactly 3 visible objects: 1 tall ceramic bottle, 1 dark glass bottle, and 1 vintage silver-and-black radio cassette player. At the lower right is 1 small stool or low table draped with newspapers, with more papers stacked underneath. The lighting should be low-key, tungsten warm indoors against cool blue night outside, with heavy film grain, soft focus, rich shadows, nostalgic realism, subtle dust, and the atmosphere of a quiet, lonely apartment from the late 1970s or 1980s.

items.title: Vintage Chinese General Store Interior
items.titleZh: A nostalgic cinematic photograph of a small old-fashioned Chinese general store interior, shot from customer eye level with a slightly wide framing. Warm sepia and amber tones, soft window light from the left, subtle film grain, faint vignette, and a slightly hazy vintage look. Behind a long dark wooden-and-glass display counter stands 1 shopkeeper, a woman with a short black bob haircut wearing a plain white short-sleeve blouse, shown in side profile while working with her hands at the counter. The store feels authentic, modest, and lived-in, like the late 1970s to 1990s. On the right side, a black vintage sewing machine sits on an upper shelf with a handwritten price sign in Chinese beside it reading “768元”. Behind it are shelves packed with small colorful product boxes and tins. On the wall hang 1 large vertical handwritten price list in Chinese calligraphy and 2 old paper calendars or posters. The foreground glass cases display many old packaged goods: stacks of colorful tins and jars, several rectangular illustrated tins, 2 enamel wash basins with floral patterns, and multiple pairs of plain white canvas shoes arranged side by side on the bottom shelf. The left side of the frame shows bright wooden-framed windows and more countertop clutter, creating strong contrast between sunlight and the dim interior. Emphasize realistic documentary photography, richly textured wood, aged surfaces, retro packaging design, quiet everyday atmosphere, and a composition that leads the eye from the woman at center-left to the sewing machine and shelves at upper right.

items.prompt:
16:9の2K画像を以下のプロンプトに基づいて3×3のグリッド画像を４枚作成して。
深夜～早朝の2010年代アキバ系オタク男子（平成後期〜令和初期の典型的なアキバ系）をテーマにしたエモーショナルな画像。但し、写真シチュエーションは<テーマ>の中から重複しないようにランダムに選んでください。
2010年代のコンパクトデジタルカメラまたはiPhone 4〜X時代の直射フラッシュを使用したスナップショットスタイル。
デジタルノイズ、軽いJPEGアーティファクト、周辺減光、暖色系のフェードトーンと少しオーバーサチュレーションが特徴的。
2010年代〜2020年初頭のデジタル写真特有のノスタルジックで生々しい質感。
儚く、少しデジタル臭い2010sスナップ写真風。
<テーマ>
・深夜のアキバ中央通り — ネオンと看板に照らされて歩く
・メイド喫茶の出口 — 萌え袖をはめたメイドと記念撮影
・ゲーセン（秋葉原）の格ゲー筐体前 — 対戦終わりに汗だくでハイタッチ
・UFOキャッチャー前 — 取ったフィギュアやぬいぐるみを自慢げに見せる
・プリクラ機の中 — フレームにデコられた痛車シール貼り
・アニメイト深夜 — 新刊ラノベや同人誌を抱えてレジ待ち
・マンガ喫茶の個室 — ブランケットにくるまりながらノートPCでエロゲー
・終電の山手線 — 痛バッグとフィギュアの袋を抱えて寝落ち
・始発電車待ちのネットカフェ — モニターの光だけが顔を照らす
・ラブホ街の路地 — ネオンに照らされた秋葉原の裏路地でたばこ
・屋上駐車場 — 夜景をバックに痛車を自慢しながらスマホチェック
・秋葉原の駅ホーム — 厚底スニーカーやドレスシューズで走る
・ゲームソフト中古店前 — 深夜閉店後に袋いっぱいの獲物を並べて撮影
・カラオケボックス — アニソン熱唱＆タンバリン（またはコスプレ）
・牛丼屋（すき家）深夜 — 夜明け前に大盛り牛丼を頬張る
・ファミレス（ガスト） — トレカやスリーブを並べてデッキ構築
・クレーンゲームの筐体前 — 景品のエロゲやフィギュアを大量ゲット
・TSUTAYA秋葉原店深夜 — アニメBD特典付きを物色
・コンビニの駐車場 — 深夜に新作ゲームの発売日を待つ行列
・タクシーの後部座席 — 痛バッグだらけの荷物と一緒に
・観覧車ゴンドラ内 — 夜景をバックに萌えグッズを見せる
・神社の境内 — 深夜に同人誌即売会の打ち上げ
・スマホ自撮り（フロントカメラ） — 部屋にフィギュア棚が映り込む
・路上でコスプレ調整 — 駅近くの路地でウィッグ直し
・朝帰りの始発電車 — 徹夜明けで疲れ果てて寝落ち
・エレベーター内 — メイド服の女の子と一緒（微妙に距離を取る）
・秋葉原の屋台ラーメン — 〆にこってりラーメンをすする
・自宅マンションの階段 — 段ボールだらけの通販荷物と一緒に
・PCパーツショップ前 — 深夜セール後の巨大なPCケースを抱える
・朝日のアキバ中央通り — スクランブル交差点のような人混みで佇む

items.title: Vintage Roaring Tiger Japanese Poster
items.titleZh: Create a bold vintage Japanese-inspired poster on a square canvas with a fierce front-facing tiger head as the single central subject, perfectly symmetrical and filling most of the frame. The tiger is roaring with its mouth wide open, showing long curved ivory fangs, smaller lower teeth, a vivid pink tongue, a dark throat, a pink nose, intense yellow eyes, and dramatic black stripes over saturated orange fur with white cheek and neck fur. Add ornamental swirling stripe patterns on the forehead to give the face a stylized mythic look. Use a gritty retro screenprint or risograph texture with visible grain, worn ink, slightly distressed edges, and a limited palette of burnt orange, black, cream, white, muted pink, and small accents of yellow. The background should be a flat textured orange-red field. In the top right, include 1 small technical diagram panel showing a side-view tiger skeleton in thin cream line art with compact vertical Japanese annotation text beneath and beside it, like a pseudo-scientific label block. In the bottom left, include 3 vertically stacked icon boxes with thin cream borders: the first contains a heart icon with the label 心, the second contains crossed bones with the label 力, and the third contains three claw marks with the label 本能. Across the bottom center, place 2 very large cream-colored Japanese kanji characters with heavy black drop shadows and a rough hand-cut block print feel: 猛獣. Keep the overall composition aggressive, iconic, poster-like, centered, and highly graphic, blending traditional Japanese poster aesthetics, tattoo flash energy, and vintage animal anatomy chart styling.

items.title: Pink Surreal Wall Street Fashion Scene
items.titleZh: A surreal fashion editorial photograph on a city street modeled after Wall Street, shot from a slightly elevated front-facing angle in a tall vertical composition. The entire environment is nearly monochrome white and pale gray, with only selective pink accents standing out vividly. In the foreground, a faceless {argument name="person" default="adult man"} stands in the middle of a crosswalk wearing a crisp white suit, white shirt, {argument name="tie color" default="pink"} tie, and glossy {argument name="shoe color" default="pink"} dress shoes, holding 1 pink balloon in his right hand and 1 pink briefcase in his left hand. To his left, 1 surreal pink giraffe emerges vertically from a round manhole in the street, wearing a white top hat and a white collar with a pink tie, smiling playfully. Behind him in the center-left lane stands 1 pink alpaca or llama dressed in a white suit with a pink tie, and perched on its head is 1 small white cat wearing a tiny pink accessory, posed upright and looking forward. The street is lined with tall classical stone buildings, repeated columns, storefront windows, rows of identical potted shrubs, and multiple pale luxury cars and taxis receding into the distance. Include visible Wall Street-style street signs near the upper left corner. The road surface, cars, buildings, and sky should all be bleached white-gray for a dreamlike high-key look, while the pink elements remain saturated: the giraffe, the alpaca, the balloon, the briefcase, the tie, and the shoes. Style: whimsical surrealism, luxury editorial photography, immaculate symmetry, soft overcast light, clean cinematic realism, uncanny yet elegant atmosphere, ultra-detailed textures, shallow facial detail on the human with the face intentionally obscured or blurred.
